* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}} / {{i|120 Volt}}: Increases the amount of arcs a spark can generate.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: The trinket activates based on the primary item slot, but it grants an extra point of charge to the second item as well.

sections.Interactions:

* {{t|Watch Battery}}: Watch Battery triggering after clearing a room will also trigger AAA Battery, provided the activated item was missing exactly 3 charges prior to clearing the room.

sections.Effects:
* Gives Isaac a 33% chance to visually turn into {{C|Azazel}} when clearing a room. Isaac keeps his hearts and items, but changes his tears to be a short range {{I|Brimstone}}, gains a x1.5 damage multiplier, a [[Speed]] increase, and the ability to [[Flight|fly]].
** The effect lasts until clearing and leaving another room.
** The effect can be taken to the next floor.
** The Speed increase is equal to the difference between the current character's base speed and Azazel's (which is 1.25). For instance, {{c|Keeper}} will gain +0.35 Speed since his base speed is 0.9.
sections.Notes:
* Dropping the trinket after this transformation will not reverse it until a new room is cleared.
* The trinket only changes Isaac's appearance to be as Azazel's but doesn't change the actual character. This means that the trinket cannot be used to unlock [[achievement]]s for Azazel.
* The effect will not change Isaac's health mechanics. For example, {{C|The Lost}} will retain his zero health and {{I|Holy Mantle}}.
* When entering the area in {{S|Mines}} / {{S|Ashpit}} to obtain {{I|Knife Piece 2}} while in the Azazel form, flight and the Brimstone laser will remain despite visually reverting.
** However, because picking up the Knife Piece triggers a room clear, the form will be reverted upon leaving the knife piece room, and the escape sequence will not benefit from the trinket's effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}} / '''multiple copies''': One boost or additional copy increases the chance of Isaac turning into Azazel to 50%. Further boosts or copies increase the chance to 100%.
* {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Isaac retains the damage multiplier and base speed increase after the effect ends. Also removes the tear delay multiplier when transformed into Azazel.
sections.Interactions:
* {{C|Azazel}}: Increases the width of his Brimstone, identical to his {{I|Birthright}} effect.
** {{i|Birthright}} as '''Azazel''': Azazel's Stump has no further effect.
* {{C|The Forgotten}}: Still uses his regular bone club attack while in skeleton form. The Soul will work as expected, and use the short-range Brimstone.
* {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: The bone pile will visually turn into Azazel, with no gameplay effects.

sections.Strategy:
* Butter! allows the transportation of active item pedestal from room to room. On its own this ability is useless, but can be used to set up plays involving room-wide pedestal effects; after gathering all available active item pedestal in a single room, Isaac can then:

** Use {{i|Void}}, {{p|Black Rune}}, or {{i|Abyss}} to consume all pedestal for their respective benefits.
** Use {{i|Diplopia}} (or more riskily {{i|Crooked Penny}}) to double all item pedestals before doing any of the above.
* Isaac can also damage himself to try to fish for the 2% chance of dropping a passive item in the same room as well.

** Since this directly affects tear delay instead of changing the tears stat, it allows Isaac's rate of fire to go over the normal maximum rate.

* Boosts [[speed]], [[range]], [[shot speed]], [[damage]], and {{dlc|r}} [[tears]] if they are above their base values.
** Affects stat bonuses from passive items, trinkets that are absorbed or in a second trinket slot, and permanent bonuses given by items such as {{i|Void}}.

** {{dlc+|r}} The extra stat upgrades are 20% of any final stat calculations over its base value (which is equivalent to {{c|Isaac}}'s base stats), for example with 4.5 damage, it is 1 damage over the base 3.5, and the 1 damage gets buffed to 1.2, ending up with a total of 4.7 damage.
*** Fire rate multipliers change what is considered to be the base value, so with {{i|Soy Milk}}, only tears ups above 15.00 will gain a bonus.

* Rerolling into items counting towards transformations (e.g.{{I|Guppy's Paw}}, {{I|Jar of Flies}}, {{I|Bob's Rotten Head}}, {{I|The Bible}} etc.) will not be counted towards said transformation, regardless if Isaac puts it back down and picks it back up.
** Having the Guppy transformation and rerolling either {{I|Guppy's Head}} or{{I|Guppy's Paw}} will remove the transformation, even if these items were acquired before using ‘M.
* Items that have costs associated with using them (such as {{i|Magic Fingers}}, {{i|Potato Peeler}}, {{i|Converter}}, etc.) can be rerolled even if Isaac doesn't have the resources necessary to use them.
** The only exception is {{i|Golden Razor}}: Isaac must have the 5 cents necessary to use it in order for it to be rerolled.
* The item's charge must be expended for it to be rerolled; items that can be used without spending their charge immediately (such as {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}, {{i|Black Hole}}, {{i|Eraser}}, {{i|Spin to Win}}, {{i|Mom's Bracelet}}, etc.) must be properly used to have their charge expended.
* ‘M cannot reroll items into {{i|Broken Shovel 1}}, {{i|Mom's Shovel}}, {{i|Hold}} or {{i|Recall}}.
* The items generated are fixed per seed. This means the same active item on the same seed while holding 'M will always reroll into the same other active item every time.
* The items rerolled into will not be removed from their item pools unless Isaac puts them down and picks them up again.
* Items can be generated multiple times, even after they have been removed from their pools.
sections.Strategy:
* Once ‘M gives a good active item, it can be dropped so that it can be continually used without it getting rerolled.
** For this reason, it is recommended to drop 'M when taking unknown pills, in case [[Gulp!]] appears, which would prevent Isaac from keeping any active item.
* Some active items have effects that can be harmful to Isaac when used; consider if rerolling the active item is worth the risk of getting an item that can't be rerolled (either at all or without hurting the run).
** {{i|Alabaster Box}} is especially noteworthy, as it cannot be rerolled, and will also prevent Isaac from gaining {{e|Soul Heart}}s until he uses or gets rid of it.
sections.Interactions:
* '''One-time use items''': The item disappears before it can be rerolled.
** {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: If Isaac has no eligible familiars, the altar can be rerolled without being consumed.
* {{i|Book of Virtues}}: If an active item is combined with the Book, only the active item is rerolled; the Book remains unchanged. If no active item is combined with the Book, the Book will be rerolled on use. ‘M also cannot give Book of Virtues, as it is considered a passive item.
* {{i|Breath of Life}}: Breath of Life is rerolled once the charge is fully expended.
** {{dlc|nr+}} After one second, Isaac starts getting hurt as if he was still using Breath of Life until he leaves the room.
* {{i|Broken Glass Cannon}}: The item is rerolled instead of turning into Glass Cannon. This item can also be given by ‘M directly.
** This only applies if you manage to obtain a charged and usable Broken Glass Cannon, as it otherwise automatically replaces itself with Glass Cannon once charged.
* {{t|Butter!}}: The active item is rerolled before being dropped.
* {{i|Car Battery}}: The current active item is used twice before it is rerolled.
* {{i|Esau Jr.}}: Isaac will transform into Esau Jr. if ‘M rerolls Isaac’s active item into Esau Jr. However, he will not transform into Esau Jr. if the item itself is used.
** As the original character will be holding ‘M, Esau Jr. must be used twice for it to be rerolled.
* {{i|Friendly Ball}} / {{i|Moving Box}}: As the item must be used twice to have its intended effect, rerolling it on the first use will prevent it from being used to its full effect.
** {{dlc|r+}} The contents of the items contained can be recovered by finding another Friendly Ball or Moving Box and using them.
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: Glowing Hourglass rewinds time before the reroll goes through, preventing it from happening. This is avoided when used during the Beast fight and will be rerolled into another active.
** If Glowing Hourglass rerolls into a rechargeable item(e.g. {{I|Spin to Win}}, {{I|The Boomerang}}), The Glass will have all its charges restored, allowing for infinite rewinding.
* {{i|Magic Skin}}: Items given by Magic Skin cannot be Magic Skin even if it’s rerolled on use. However, as Isaac will not be holding Magic Skin after using it, it will be able to replace future items after being rerolled.
* {{i|Notched Axe}}: The item will be rerolled once it runs out of durability.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: Only the primary item is rerolled.

sections.Effect:
* {{R|Treasure Room}}s appear in the {{s|Womb}}, {{s|Utero}}, and {{s|Scarred Womb}}.
* {{dlc+|r}} Treasure Rooms also appear in the {{s|Corpse}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Notes:
* This trinket must already be held upon starting the Womb/Utero/Scarred Womb floor for the effect to take place, i.e., the trinket needs to be carried over from the previous floor.
* Bloody Crown only needs to be held when entering the floor. The Treasure Room will remain after dropping the trinket, even if it hasn't been explored yet.
* {{Curse|XL}} floors will have 2 treasure rooms, like any other XL floor.
* {{Dlc|r}}The Treasure Rooms that appear in Corpse will have 2 items, one behind a {{curse|blind}} like the other Alt Path floors.
* This trinket does not work if held during a challenge run that impedes {{R|Treasure Room}}s from spawning.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Treasure rooms in the Womb have an item choice, as if Isaac had {{i|More Options}}.

sections.Effects:
* Grants one {{e|Bone Heart}} container upon entering a new floor.
** If Isaac has 12 heart containers, the added bone heart will replace the rightmost {{e|Soul Heart}} (if any).

* Every {{r|Treasure Room}} is replaced with a {{r|Devil Treasure Room}} which contains items from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]] that can be bought for the usual number of [[Heart Container]]s normally requested (for the spawned item) in a {{r|Devil Room}}.
sections.Notes:
* The {{r|Devil Treasure Room}} generated will be the same as the {{r|Treasure Room}} that would have been generated, minus the item and room textures.
** Multiple-choice Treasure Rooms, such as those generated in alternative floors and {{s|???}}, allow both items to be taken upon being converted to Devil Treasure Rooms. The blind item on alternate floors will still be blind, however.
** [[Rocks#Urns|Urns]], [[Rocks#Mushrooms|mushrooms]], [[Rocks#Polyps|polyps]], and [[Rocks#Buckets|buckets]] will be converted into [[Rocks#Skulls|skulls]].
* This trinket also converts Treasure rooms on the current floor when picked up. However, this only affects Treasure Rooms that have not been visited yet.
** The same goes vice-versa: dropping the trinket will convert Devil Treasure Rooms to normal ones unless they've been visited.
* Items bought in the Devil Treasure Rooms will affect {{r|Angel Room}} chance like a normal [[Deal with the Devil]] would.
* When entering floors during the [[Ascent]], Treasure Rooms visited during the run will keep their previous state, and will be unaffected by this trinket.
** However, unvisited Treasure Rooms can still be converted by dropping and picking up the trinket.
* Does not affect the Silver Treasure Rooms in [[Greed Mode]].
* Extra treasure rooms generated by {{i|Red Key}} will be affected normally.
* Items spawned in Devil Treasure Rooms (e.g via {{I|Magic Skin}}, {{P|VI - The Lovers?}}, {{P|XVII - The Stars?}}, etc.) will all be drawn from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]].
* Devil's Crown does not affect the reversed Treasure Room in {{s|Downpour}}/{{s|Dross}} II.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|r+}} {{A|Golden Trinket|n}} / {{I|Mom's Box|n}}: Having either makes treasure rooms have a 25% chance of becoming a {{T|Number Magnet|n}} variant. Having both increases the chance to 33%.
** Getting this counts as Skipping the {{r|Treasure Room}}. Giving {{r|Planetarium}} Chance.
* {{I|Coupon}}: When used in a {{R|Devil Treasure Room}}, gives the item for free, acting like a regular {{R|Treasure Room}} but with devil items, only requiring the use of Coupon.
** This doesnt affect the {{R|Angel Room}} chance, like how using {{I|Coupon}} in a regular {{R|Devil Room}} and grabbing the free item wouldn't.
* {{I|Dream Catcher}}: Shows you the item that spawns without the trinket, allowing you to drop the trinket before entering if you think the treasure room item would be better than the devil deal.
* {{I|Glowing Hourglass}}: Allows you to check the item that spawns with and without the trinket, letting you pick the better item.
* {{i|More Options}}: All {{r|Devil Treasure Room}}s will have two items, both of which can be purchased.
** This also extends to {{T|Broken Glasses}}, {{T|Golden Horse Shoe}} and {{P|XVII - The Stars}} cards buffed by {{I|Tarot Cloth}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Redemption}}: Devil Treasure Rooms will count as regular {{r|Devil Room}}s for the purposes of this item.

sections.Effects:
* While held, acts as one of the three items needed for {{tf|Guppy}}.
** The effect is lost if Kid's Drawing is dropped.
** This includes instantly losing the transformation if dropping the trinket results in having only 2 out of 3 Guppy items required for the transformation.
sections.Notes: * If multiple copies of the trinket are obtained, they will each count as a Guppy item.
sections.Interactions:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}}: Counts as holding 2 Guppy items.
* {{i|Mom's Box}}: No effect, even with {{A|Golden Trinket}}.
** {{dlc|r+}} The Internal Item Description claims otherwise. See [[#Bugs|bugs]].

sections.Effects: * Causes a {{R|Treasure Room}} and {{R|Shop}} to generate in {{s|Cathedral}}.
sections.Notes:
* Cannot appear in [[Greed Mode]].
* The spawned Treasure Room will have one of 23 unique layouts for the floor.
* {{i|Card Reading}} will spawn a second portal if Isaac has the trinket upon entering Cathedral.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Treasure rooms in the Cathedral have an item choice, as if Isaac had {{i|More Options}} and Shops will be upgraded. Having both reveals the locations of the treasure room and the shop on the map.

sections.Effects: * Grants a chance of being healed for a {{E|Half Red Heart}} upon clearing a room.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|a}} Can be triggered upon clearing a wave in [[Greed Mode]].
* The chance to be healed depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5  \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r}}: Having either doubles the heal to a {{E|Red Heart}}. Having both triples it to 1 and a half heart.

sections.Effects:
* Upon entering a room, each enemy has a 20% chance to be [[Status Effects|petrified]] for 4 seconds. Enemies that have been petrified by Ice Cube are [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] when killed, {{dlc|nr+}} including those killed up to 2 seconds after the petrifaction effect ends.
** The chance for enemies to be petrified increases with [[luck]], reaching 100% at 40 Luck.
sections.Notes:
* Enemies spawned in waves are not petrified.
* Bosses can be petrified, but cannot be frozen.
* Every room has a predetermined set of enemies that are going to be petrified. Re-entering the room will not change this, similarly to [[Champion]] enemies.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either increase the base chance to petrify enemies upon entering a room to 33%. Having both increase the base chance to 50%.
* {{t|Second Hand}}: Extends the time period that allows for enemies to be frozen after the petrifaction effect ends from 2 to 6 seconds.

sections.Notes:
* This trinket has a chance to drop from destroying [[Rocks#Mushrooms|mushrooms]].
* {{Dlc|nr}} If the Compass effect triggers while having the {{i|Treasure Map}}, the Compass effect is permanent for the remainder of the floor. (Other Mushroom effects will still apply in each room with their normal odds.)
* By walking into and out of a room, Liberty Cap will change its effect.
** {{Dlc|nr}} This can be used to easily get the Compass effect.
** {{Dlc|r}} This can be used to easily get the Magic Mushroom effect before {{r|Boss Rush}} or {{e|Dogma|n}} (as the Dogma boss room door will only close when touching the middle of the room).
sections.Synergies: * {{a|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r}} : One boost or copy increases the chance for activation to 50%, further copies to 100%.

sections.Effect:
* +15% chance for a {{r|Treasure Room}} with two items to spawn on subsequent floors.
** Only one of the two items can be taken, the other will disappear.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} Also applies to trinkets spawned in Treasure rooms during [[Pica Run]] Challenge.
* {{dlc|r}} Also applies during [[Ascent]] to any Treasure Rooms that were not previously opened.
sections.Synergies:
* {{T|Pay to Win|a+nr}}: If Golden Horse Shoe activates, both items can be taken.
* {{T|Broken Glasses}}: The second item will always be blind if not on the alt path.
** This doesn't apply with {{I|More Options}}.
* {{i|Mom's Box}} / {{A|Golden Trinket|r}}: Increases the chance to 30%.

sections.Effects:
* Bolts of electricity arc between Isaac and his [[familiar]]s, damaging any enemies between them.
** The bolts do 6 points of damage per strike.
** The bolts flow through each familiar in reverse order of acquisition, and reach Isaac last.
** A bolt arcs every 2 seconds with one familiar. 3 of them arc per second with two familiars. 7.5 per second with three or more familiars.
sections.Notes:
* Does not affect [[Familiar#Temporary Familiars|temporary familiars]] or {{i|The Swarm}}’s gray flies.
* The bolts will damage destructible [[obstacles]], such as {{g|TNT}} and {{E|Fire Place}}s, as a normal tear would.
* {{Dlc|r}} In [[True co-op]], electricity will arc to all characters, as well as all their familiars.
sections.Interactions:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Each copy deals 6 more damage per tick.
* {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Bolts will arc between it and {{C|The Soul}} / {{C|Tainted Soul}}.
* {{C|Jacob and Esau}}: Electricity will arc to familiars held by both characters, not just the familiars owned by the character holding it. It will also arc between Jacob and Esau themselves.

sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{I|Mom's Box}} / {{t|Faded Polaroid|r}}: Each trinket copy stacks, lengthening the duration of the confusion and visual effect per stack.

sections.Effects: * +2 flat [[damage]].
sections.Notes:
* Since Curved Horn grants flat damage, it is not affected by the damage up formula, which normally gives diminishing returns for each new damage up.
* Curved Horn is affected by most damage multipliers, excluding {{i|Polyphemus}}, {{i|Mega Mush}}, and character multipliers (such as {{c|Azazel}}'s 1.5x damage multiplier).
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: Having either increases Damage by 4. Having both by 6.

sections.Effect:
* {{e|Red Heart}} damage will be taken before {{e|Soul Heart}}, {{e|Black Heart}}, and {{e|Rotten Heart}} damage.
** With {{e|Bone Heart}}s, Red Hearts contained within the Bone Hearts will be taken before regular Red Heart damage.
** If Isaac {{dlc|nr}} only has half a Red Heart left / {{dlc|r}} has no Red Hearts left, Soul and Black Heart damage will be taken, and Bone Hearts can be destroyed.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} This is useful for getting into {{R|Boss Challenge Room}}s while maintaining Soul/Black Hearts.
** {{dlc|r}} No longer works as Boss Challenge Rooms now require one heart in total.
* Red Heart damage taken via the trinket affects {{R|Devil Room}}/{{R|Angel Room}} chances normally.
** This can be used to voluntarily decrease the Angel / Devil room chance if it has already been accessed in favor of increased chance next floor.
** If Isaac has at least one {{e|Rotten Heart}}, he does not lose deal chance from taking any red heart damage, despite rotten hearts not being taken first.
*** This means having just a single rotten heart can be a great strategy for removing the majority of the downside of this trinket.
* Although {{e|Gold Heart}}s are in front of the HP bar, they will shatter when red heart damage is taken through the trinket.
* This trinket is useful when playing as {{C|The Forgotten}}, as it will preserve his Bone Hearts (and Devil/Angel Room chance) until all of his Bone Hearts are empty.
** This trinket does nothing while controlling {{C|The Soul}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Adds a 25% chance that taking damage does not reduce Devil room chances. Having both brings the chance to avoid reduction to 50%.

sections.Effects:
* Fully recharges Isaac's active item upon entering an unexplored {{r|Boss Room}}.
** This effect only occurs the first time a Boss Room is entered; leaving and re-entering the Boss Room will not result in more recharges.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Active item will be overcharged.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: Increases arcing distance of sparks.
* {{p|IV - The Emperor?}}: The currently held active item is fully charged the first time the extra boss room is teleported to. The normal boss room also charges the active item.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|The Battery}}: If the item doesn't have a full first charge level, it will be filled. If the first level is full, the second charge level will be filled.
** {{dlc|r}} The item will gain both its charges.
* {{i|Mega Blast}}: Mega Blast gains only 3 charge units, unlike all other 12 room recharge items, which are fully charged.

sections.Effect: * Spawns 1-2 [[blue flies]] every time Isaac takes damage.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: Spawns 2-4 [[blue flies]] on hit. Having both increases to 3-6 blue flies per hit.

sections.Effects:
* Gives a random [[trinket]] effect for each room.
** {{dlc|nr+}} There is no indication as to which trinket effect Isaac gets.
** {{dlc|r+}} The trinket will transform into a red-coloured version of the trinket it's copying.
sections.Notes:
* Each room is locked to a single trinket effect, meaning that even if Isaac exits and re-enters a room, that room will always have the same trinket effect.
* In rooms where the {{t|Tick}} effect is given, Isaac is unable to swap Error with another trinket.
* If the {{t|Store Credit}} effect is given in a Shop, all items will be free and Error will not be consumed.
* If the {{t|Monkey Paw}} effect is given, Error will never be consumed and can continue to spawn {{e|Black Heart}}s indefinitely.
* {{dlc+|a+}} If the {{t|Bag Lunch}}, {{t|Walnut}}, or {{t|Wish Bone}} effect is given, the trinket will not be consumed and will continue to spawn [[items]] upon taking damage.
** {{dlc|nr}} Touching a {{E|Stoney}} and {{E|Movable TNT}} counts as taking damage and will spawn a lot of items.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} If the {{t|Your Soul}} effect is given, all Devil Deals will be free and Error will not be consumed.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} Error cannot give the effects of trinkets Isaac is currently holding (with {{i|Mom's Purse}} or {{i|Belly Button}}) or ones that were [[Smelter|gulped]].
** Therefore, somehow gulping all the trinkets in one run will make this trinket useless.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either increases the effect of the copied [[trinket]] if possible. Having both further increases the effect if possible.

sections.Effect: * [[Angel]]s drop items from the [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room item pool]] instead of key pieces when defeated.
sections.Notes:
* Items are dropped even if both key pieces are already acquired.
** {{dlc|r}} If one key piece was acquired before picking up Filigree Feather, the next time the angel that normally drops the key piece Isaac currently has is defeated, it will drop the other key piece even with Filigree Feather equipped. (E.g. defeating Uriel while holding Key Piece 1 and Filigree Feather will drop Key Piece 2, but defeating Gabriel with the same items will drop an angel item instead.)
*** {{dlc|r+}} Key Piece drops are prioritized. 
**** For example, after fighting Angels for the first time they will drop Key Pieces. If both pieces are picked up, next time Angels will drop items upon defeat.
**** If only one Key Piece is picked up, an Angel defeated in the next room will drop another Key Piece, and the next Angel in the same room will drop an item. If a remaining Key Piece is not picked up again, an Angel fought in a third room will drop the missing Key Piece again.
* {{Dlc|nr}} If both Angels are fought at the same time, only the last one defeated will drop an item.
* Isaac can drop the Filigree Feather, fight the Angel, then grab the trinket again if a Key Piece is desired.
* Only Angels that would otherwise drop a Key Piece will drop an item. This means that those who spawn during the {{e|Mega Satan}} fight, {{R|Boss Rush}} or those rarely found in [[closet]]s in the {{s|Cathedral}} do not drop items, but ones found in some {{R|Super Secret Room}}s and those summoned from {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s do.
*Considering that {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s always spawn 2 Angels, and Isaac can get 1 Angel deal each floor, Filigree Feather can potentially generate a ludicrous 3 Angel items per floor.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Defeated angels drop a {{e|Half Soul Heart}} in addition to whatever else they drop.
* {{i|Meat Cleaver}}: Each angel gives an item.
** {{Dlc|r+}} Only one item will drop.
* {{i|The Stairway}}: Allows for an extra Angel in the Angel Shop every floor.
sections.Interactions: * {{C|Jacob and Esau}}: Jacob must be the one holding Filigree Feather for the trinket to work properly.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a blood clot [[Familiar]] on the ground near Isaac. The familiar copies Isaac's movement and attacks, but deals only 35% of Isaac's [[damage]].
** The clot will die after taking damage 3 times.
* If Isaac does not currently have a clot from this trinket, a new one spawns when entering a room.
sections.Notes:
* Holding the "drop" button lets Isaac move independently from Lil Clot.
* Lil Clot will persist after the trinket is dropped, but it will not respawn unless the trinket is picked up again.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{I|Mom's Box}} / {{t|Lil Clot}}: Grants an additional clot, which will also respawn if the trinket is held.
* {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases the damage to 70% of Isaac's.
* {{T|Found Soul}}: The ghost familiar receives its own floating Lil Clot that acts the same way as Isaac's, vanishing when the ghost dies.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The clot's tear floats the same way Isaac's tear does.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Clot's tears travel along the beam regardless of its location.

sections.Effects:
* Increases all [[Attributes|stats]] while Isaac's active item is completely uncharged:
** +0.50 [[speed]].
** +1.50 [[range]].
** {{dlc|nr}} +1.00 [[tear falling speed]]
** {{dlc|nr}} +0.40 [[tears]].
** {{dlc|r}} +0.50 [[tears]].
** +0.30 [[shot speed]].
** +1.5 [[damage]].
** +2 [[luck]].
sections.Notes:
* Dim Bulb is more than twice as powerful as {{t|Vibrant Bulb}}; however, its effects are active less frequently.
** However, 1 room charge items can be used at the start of each room to effectively get the Dim Bulb's effects constantly.
* Items that charge automatically will get only a tiny moment of benefit from the Dim Bulb before they gain more charge again.
* {{dlc|nr}} Items with no charge bar like {{i|How to Jump}} will activate Dim Bulb's effects permanently as long as the item is held.
* Dim Bulb has no effect when no active item is held.
* If Isaac has 2 items (via {{i|Schoolbag}}), {{dlc|nr+}} both of them need to be empty to receive the benefits / {{dlc|r+}} only the currently held item needs to be empty to receive the benefits.
** {{dlc|nr}} However, if one of the two active items has no charge bar (e.g. {{i|Remote Detonator}}), it can be swapped to, preserving the Bulb's effect.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|4.5 Volt}}: Dim Bulb will be active for as long as the active item has less than one bar of charge.
* {{C|Bethany}} / {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: The effect remains active with both soul and blood charges.
** If the active item is fully charged only with soul/blood charges and no regular charges, {{T|Vibrant Bulb}} can be active simultaneously with Dim Bulb.
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either doubles the stat increases. Having both triples them.
* {{T|Old Capacitor}}: As long as the active item uses charges, Dim Bulb can be held active indefinitely.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|9 Volt}}: Renders Dim Bulb useless, save for 1 charge items.
* {{dlc|r}} Dim Bulb produces no effect with active items in consumable slots, such as {{c|Tainted Apollyon}}'s {{i|Abyss|n}}, {{c|Tainted Bethany}}'s {{i|Lemegeton|n}} or {{C|Tainted Magdalene}}'s {{I|Yum Heart}}.

sections.Effects: * [[Devil Deal]]s only cost 1 [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heart container]].
sections.Notes:
* Soul heart trades still cost 3 {{e|Soul Heart}}s, rendering this item useless for characters that can only have soul, black or bone hearts.
** {{Dlc|r}} An exception can be made for {{C|???}} as the tongue reduces devil deal prices as normal.
* Judas' Tongue can retroactively change the price of devil deals.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|A Pound of Flesh}} / {{T|Keeper's Bargain}} / {{C|Keeper|r}} / {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: The tongue provides no discounts for any item costing money.
* {{a|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Also reduces the cost of soul heart items by 1 soul heart. Having both also guarantees {{r|Devil Room}} sacrifice items on the first pay (instead of 50%).

sections.Effects:
* Makes Isaac's tears 50% wider, giving them an oblong appearance.
* Increases tears' natural [[knockback]] slightly.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Pin}}, {{e|Larry Jr.}}, {{e|The Hollow}}, or {{e|Scolex}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}}/{{I|Mom's Box|r}}: Each copy further increases width of Isaac's tears.

sections.Effect: * When Isaac uses a [[HUD#Card/Pill Slots|consumable pickup]] like a pill or card, there is a 25% chance to spawn another copy of it.
sections.Notes:
* Endless Nameless is especially useful when used with item multiplier [[Cards and Runes#Playing Cards|playing cards]].
* The new consumable will spawn before the effect goes through. This means teleportation will leave the new copy in the previous room, {{dlc+|nr}} and item conversion or destruction cards like {{p|Ace of Diamonds}} and {{p|Black Rune}} will consume the new copy{{dlc-}}.
sections.Synergies:
* [[Pills|Vurp!]] + {{i|D20}}: Consuming two Vurp! pills consecutively can spawn an infinite amount of Vurp! pills.
* {{a|Gold Pill}}: A new gold pill may be spawned with each use, allowing for very easy exploitation (if Isaac has an item that removes negative effects).
* {{a|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either of these effects raises the chance to 33%. Having both of them raises the chance to 50%.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Blank Card}} / {{i|Placebo}} / {{i|Clear Rune}}: Consumable effects activated by the items do not generate copies of it.
* {{i|Echo Chamber}}: Echoed effects do not spawn their corresponding consumable, only the one used will have a chance to reappear.
* {{p|XIV - Temperance?}}: The card may only copy itself, not the pill effects it generates.

sections.Effects: * +2.0 [[fire rate]] as long as Isaac's held pickups are all the same number.
sections.Notes:

sections.Effects:

** The ghost uses Isaac's [[speed]], [[tears]], [[range]], [[shot speed]], [[tear effects]], and [[trinkets]], and deals half of Isaac's [[damage]].
** The familiar has collision and can be separated. Holding down the "drop" button keeps the familiar in place.
* The familiar dies after taking any damage, and will respawn on the next floor.
sections.Notes:
* When Isaac places a {{e|Bomb}}, the familiar will drop one as well at no cost.
* The familiar can press {{g|Pressure Plate}}s.
* If Found Soul touches a {{e|Devil Beggar}}, {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}, or {{e|Confessional}}s, it will use the machine or beggar once for free before dying.
* Keeping Found Soul alive is crucial for exploration bonus boost in daily runs.
* Although the familiar dies from any damage initially, it is possible for it to obtain health and survive multiple hits with help of effects such as {{t|Hollow Heart}}.
** If Found Soul obtains an empty [[heart container]], it is possible to heal it by collecting a {{e|Red Heart}}. Isaac's heart containers must be full for this to happen.
* {{dlc|nr+}} If Found Soul is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning {{t|Perfection}}, even if Isaac hasn't been hit.
sections.Interactions:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either increase the soul's damage to 75% of Isaac's damage. Having both increase its damage to Isaac's damage.
* {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|The Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Forgotten}} / {{C|Tainted Lilith}} / {{C|Tainted Magdalene}} / {{C|Tainted Samson}}: The soul uses none of their inherent tear modifiers or special attacks.

* {{I|Anima Sola}}: Chains two enemies at once. Using the item again will free only one of them.
* {{T|Baby-Bender}}: No homing on the soul.
* {{i|Aquarius}}: The damage from creep is not halved for the soul.
* {{I|Bag of Crafting}}: The soul will swing its own bag alongside Isaac collecting any pickups it hits resulting in pickup disappearance.
* {{I|BFFS!}}: Does not affect the soul.
* {{I|Book of the Dead}}: Bonies will follow the soul. The orbitals will still orbit around Isaac.
* {{I|Breath of Life}}: No effect on the soul.

* {{i|Dark Arts}}: The soul will use Dark Arts along with Isaac. Enemies can be marked by both Isaac and the soul. It will gain its own damage boost.
* {{I|Dead Sea Scrolls}} / {{I|Metronome}}: The soul will double only the active effects that it can double.
* {{I|Dream Catcher}}: The soul will receive half a soul heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to, allowing him to survive multiple hits and gather up to a maximum of 12 soul hearts. His health resets when the trinket is dropped.

* {{I|Eye of Greed}}: Coin tears fired still subtract coins.

* {{I|Guillotine}}: No head orbital is granted to the soul. Other stats still apply.

When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.

sections.Effects:
* Has a 50% chance to give Isaac a one-time use [[Dice (Disambiguation)|Dice item]] in a consumable slot when he enters a new room. The dice disappears when he leaves the room, and cannot be dropped.
** This doesn't replace any consumables Isaac already has.
sections.Notes:
* If Isaac leaves and re-enters a room, Dice Bag will not try to give another die when Isaac re-enters it.
* The dice given are determined by the amount of rooms cleared, and are not actually tied to specific rooms.
** This is the opposite of how {{t|Modeling Clay}} works.
* Any die can be given to Isaac, including ones that haven't been unlocked yet.
* Dice Bag cannot give {{i|Spindown Dice}}, {{i|D infinity}}, {{t|Cracked Dice}}, or {{p|Dice Shard}}.
* Dropping the trinket on the ground does not remove dice until Isaac leaves the room.
** This means that the D1 can always be used on the Dice Bag to spawn another trinket.
* If a D4 or D100 die is used, it won't reroll your active item. This is likely because the code for the dice consumable was directly copied from the items themselves, and because the D4 and D100 doesn't reroll your active item (themselves), neither can the dice consumables.
sections.Strategy:
* Be cautious when carrying cards and/or pills. The die given by Dice Bag will always be first in the consumable queue, so one unaware press of the "use consumable" button can lead to Isaac's build getting fully rerolled.
* [[Card]]s, [[pill]]s, and [[Cards and Runes#Runes|runes/soul stones]] can be held until Dice Bag gives a D1 to get a chance at an extra copy of them.
* Cards/[[item]]s that can spawn items when used (such as {{p|XX - Judgement}} or {{i|Mystery Gift}}) can be held until Dice Bag gives an (Eternal) D6 to reroll the items they give before the die goes away.
sections.Synergies:

* {{i|Book of Virtues}}: Creates wisps as if the equivalent active item was used.
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: The die given in the room Isaac used Glowing Hourglass in will be granted in the next new room Isaac visits, regardless of what it is. This can be strategically used to get a D6 or Eternal D6 at the optimal moment.
* {{i|Moving Box}}: Can be used to hold undesirable items and pickups until Dice Bag grants a consumable that can reroll them.

sections.Effects:
* Tears move shifting left to right on a square-wave-like path.
* {{dlc|nr}} +10 [[Range]].
* {{dlc|r}} +1.5 [[Range]], +0.4 [[Tears]].
* {{dlc|r}} Grants [[spectral tears]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Pin}}, {{e|Larry Jr.}}, {{e|The Hollow}} or {{e|Scolex}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|nr}} Effective range remains the same because the range buff only compensates for the tears tracing a longer path.
* {{dlc|r}} Effective range is a bit lower, by about 1 tile.
* {{dlc|nr}} Shooting with this trinket equipped when next to a wall or block may cause the tear to travel into the wall.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r}}: In addition to the further stats increase, the square-wave-like pattern has a bigger amplitude.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Brimstone}} / {{I|Tech.5}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Technology 2}} / {{I|Revelation}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: Effect applies to the Brimstone beam, effectively increasing the width of the beam.
** {{dlc|nr}} It also adds an extra tick to the Brimstone beam.

* {{C|The Forgotten}}: Bone club does not get any wider or attack any further {{dlc|r}} though he will still benefit from the tears up, making the trinket's main effect only work on {{C|The Soul}}.
* {{i|Tiny Planet}} / {{i|Tech X}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Chance to spawn up to 1 {{i|Dead Bird}} [[familiar]] for the current [[Rooms|room]] each time an enemy dies.
** The Dead Bird deals 4 damage per second.
** The chance increases with [[luck]], starting at 5% at 0 luck and reaching 100% at 8 luck.
** The familiar spawns already activated, with no taking damage required unlike the item.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Increases chance to spawn {{i|Dead Bird}} by additional 5% per stack.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|r}} [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can’t spawn the bird familiar.
* {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t spawn the bird familiar.
* {{I|Box of Friends}}: No effect.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Sacrifices the familiar, destroying the trinket and generating an item normally.
* {{dlc|rnr+}} [[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t spawn the bird familiar.

sections.Effects:

** {{dlc|a+}} The teleportation happens only at half a heart or less left, regardless of health type. Empty {{E|Bone Heart|n}}s are not counted as health even if they can absorb a hit.

sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Scapular}}: Provided Scapular can always trigger, grants effective immortality, as the soul heart is always given before the teleport takes place.
** +{{I|The Wafer}}: Grants true immortality, plus one hit on the soul heart, allowing the player to get hit once before teleporting.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a random friendly {{E|Dip}} upon clearing a room.
** Spawns a random friendly Dip upon starting a new wave in [[Greed Mode]].
* Turns enemy Dips into friendly Dips, similar to {{I|Dirty Mind}}.
* Dips come in [[Poops]] variants rather than Dip variants. Golden variants drop coins on being damaged and can turn enemies into gold. Red variants do extra damage. Rainbow variants turn into a heart upon death. White variants are harder to kill. Black and Corny variants have had no extra visible effects.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}}/{{I|Mom's Box}}: Grants 1 extra dip per copy. Also, dip enemies become friendly.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac's severed head will follow him as a [[familiar]] firing [[piercing tears]] that deal 3.5 [[damage]] with each shot.
** {{dlc|nr}} The head shoots once per second.
** {{dlc|r}} The head shoots once every 3/4ths of a second.

** This resets upon quitting and re-entering the game.

** {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar]]s that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Isaac's Head having {{dlc|nr+}} 5th / {{dlc|r+}} 7th priority.

sections.Effects:
* 80% of [[Hearts|heart]] drops are replaced with {{e|Key}}s.
* All heart drops turn into {{e|Black Heart}}s, if possible. (Sometimes heart types are tied to the room, such as in certain {{R|Super Secret Room}}s.)
sections.Notes:
* Objects and items such as [[tinted rock]]s, {{e|Red Chest}}s, {{e|Fortune Telling Machine}}s, {{i|Little C.H.A.D.}}, {{t|Bloody Penny}}, or {{E|Blue Fire Place}}s can't drop {{e|Black Heart}}s. Thus, they will still drop {{e|Soul Heart}}s/{{e|Red Heart}}s with Daemon's Tail.
* {{i|Glyph of Balance}} can still force drops to be Red Hearts if the proper conditions are met.
* {{dlc+|a+}} All heart drops from {{p|Ace of Hearts}} will be Black Hearts.{{dlc-}}
* No effect on {{P|Queen of Hearts}}, {{p|V - The Hierophant}}, {{p|V - The Hierophant?}}, and {{p|VI - The Lovers}}.
* {{p|VIII - Justice}} is affected by the heart pickup reduction, however its Red Heart drop will be replaced if it spawns.
* Sources of heart drops that are reduced include cleared rooms, [[boss]]es, {{e|Slot Machine}}s, {{e|Fortune Telling Machine}}s, {{e|Beggar}}s, {{e|Fire Place}}s, {{E|Chest}}s, {{e|Red Chest}}s, {{g|Poop}}s, [[tinted rock]]s, items ({{i|Gimpy}}, {{i|Old Bandage}}, {{i|Fanny Pack}}), trinkets ({{t|Bloody Penny}}), and familiars ({{i|Little C.H.A.D.}}, {{i|The Relic}}, etc).
** Hearts that are present upon entering a room for the first time are unaffected by the reduction (for example, the ones found in {{R|Curse Room}}s/{{R|Devil Room}}s/{{R|Angel Room}}s), but will be converted to Black Hearts.
*** The exceptions to this are particular {{R|Super Secret Room}}s, which have the effect of forcing all heart drops to be the kind found within them.
** {{dlc|na+}}The {{p|V - The Hierophant}} and {{p|VI - The Lovers}} [[tarot card]]s have a chance to drop one heart instead of two.
* Things that can drop pickups other than hearts will keep the same chance to drop a consumable, but with an increased chance for drops other than hearts and a decreased chance for heart drops. In particular, this increases the chances of acquiring:
** [[Tarot card]]s & [[trinket]]s from {{e|Fortune Telling Machine}}s
** {{e|Bomb}}s and {{e|Key}}s from [[tinted rock]]s
** [[Pill]]s and items from {{e|Red Chest}}s
** [[Coin]]s from {{g|Poop}}s and {{e|Fire Place}}s
** Any pickup from {{e|Slot Machine}}s, cleared rooms, {{e|Beggar}}s, {{E|Chest}}s, and the Fanny Pack.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Blue and purple fires drop {{e|Black Heart}}s instead of {{e|Soul Heart}}.
* {{t|Black Feather}}: Black Feather grants a damage boost for Daemon's Tail, provided Isaac has an extra trinket slot ({{dlc|a+}} or has gulped/smelted either of the trinkets).
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Box}}: The Red Heart drop will not be reduced and will always be replaced by a Black Heart.
* {{i|Crystal Ball}}: The chance to drop Cards or Runes will change to 90%/10% in favor of cards.
* {{i|Squeezy}} / {{i|Mr. Dolly}} / {{i|Marrow}}: Heart drops are unaffected.
sections.Tips:
* Due to its specific mechanic, Daemon's Tail has no synergy with items increasing chances for Soul/Eternal/Black Hearts to drop instead of a Red Heart, like {{i|Mitre}}, {{t|Mom's Pearl}}, or {{t|Bible Tract}}.
* Since the frequency of heart drops is lowered, holding this trinket can be dangerous to Isaac if he has numerous [[Health#Red Heart Containers|Red Heart containers]], as he can easily find himself short on health.
** This trinket is more effective for {{c|???}}, {{c|Tainted ???}}, {{dlc|r}}{{c|Black Judas}}, {{c|Tainted Judas}}, and {{c|Tainted Forgotten}} because they cannot gain red heart containers or fill their {{e|Bone Heart}}s with red hearts.
** The trinket is also beneficial for {{c|The Lost}}, {{c|Tainted Lost}}, {{c|Keeper}}, and {{c|Tainted Keeper}} since it replaces useless hearts with other pickups.
* {{t|Mom's Pearl}} or {{t|Bible Tract}} are trinkets which only need to be held to be useful, whereas Daemon's Tail is more effective if it is held and dropped at the right times, to get an increased chance for consumables from certain mechanics (to counter a lack of {{e|Bomb}}s/{{e|Key}}s/[[coin]]s, or to get {{e|Black Heart}} protection), and to still get enough heart drops to stay alive at other times (from bosses or familiars).
** This trinket nearly requires this kind of strategy to pay off, making it tough to use as the player will have to sort and remember the moments where they must pick up or drop the trinket, as it interacts with nearly every consumable dropping mechanic.

sections.Effects:
* Doubles the fire rate of Isaac's [[familiar]]s.
** Familiars with charged shots will have their charge time halved. The recovery time between shots is not affected.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|The Siren}}.{{dlc-}}

sections.Interactions:

* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either applies a 2.5x multiplier on the fire rate of familiars. Having both triples their fire rate.
* {{i|Incubus}} / {{i|Twisted Pair}}: As the familiars depend on Isaac's fire rate, Incubus and Twisted Pair work normally up to moderately high fire rates around 10. Beyond that, however, Forgotten Lullaby starts to lose effect: at 27.5 fire rate e.g. achievable with {{i|Soy Milk}} there no longer is any improvement and going even higher the trinket becomes detrimental, halving the familiars' damage output at the absolute maximum of 120 fire rate.

* {{i|Hushy|r+}}: No effect on Hushy.

sections.Effect:
* +0.15 [[speed]].
** {{dlc|nr}} Also affects maximum speed, may never exceed 2.0.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}}/{{i|Mom's Box}}: Having either increases speed by 0.3. Having both by 0.45.

sections.Effects: * Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals ×3.2 Isaac's [[damage]].
sections.Notes:

* {{i|Tough Love}}: Activation rates are individually applied to each tear, effectively allowing for higher amounts of teeth.

sections.Effects:
* [[Familiar]]s that are bound to Isaac's movement will be stuck in place relative to his position.
** This includes [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital familiars]], [[Familiar#Shooting Familiars|shooting familiars]] and {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar#Mimicking Familiars|mimicking familiars]].
sections.Notes:
* Familiars are stopped in the exact position they are when Duct Tape is picked up. Position of familiars can be changed by dropping Duct Tape and picking it up again.
* Blue Flies and familiars that attack nearby enemies such as {{i|Gemini}} will be stuck, but will still target enemies as usual if within range.
* [[Familiar#Throwable familiars|Throwable familiars]] such as {{i|Little Chubby}} will still charge forward and will also return to the same spot each time.
* By dropping Duct Tape directly outside of a door, then exiting and re-entering through the same door, all familiars will be perfectly centered on Isaac's position.
sections.Interactions:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Tapping the drop button will cycle familiars into various formations.
* {{i|Ball of Bandages}} / {{i|Cube of Meat}}: No effect at level 3 and 4.
* {{I|Dry Baby}} / {{I|Farting Baby}}: If properly positioned, it can greatly protect Isaac from projectiles.
** This same technique can be used with {{C|Lilith}} to shoot with more accuracy.
* {{t|Friendship Necklace}} + {{i|Spin to Win|n}}: Familiars affected by Friendship Necklace are still considered orbitals regardless of positioning allowing Isaac to use their contact damage without getting close to enemies. Duct Tape also prevents familiars that weren't already orbitals from flashing when Spin to Win is used despite still being affected by the active item.
* {{i|Multidimensional Baby|r}}: If properly positioned, Isaac's tears will always be doubled.

* If an item that costs health is rerolled (via {{i|The D6}} or similar methods), the new item can cost coins instead. The reverse is also true.

sections.Effects: * Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Adds a high chance to spawn a {{E|Lil' Battery}} when clearing a room, independent of the room's original drop.
sections.Notes:
* The exact chance for a battery dropping is <math>\min(20\% + (3\% * \mathit{Luck}) , 33\%)</math>.
** This means that the chance starts at 20% at 0 Luck, minimizes at 0% at -6.67 Luck, and maximizes at 33% at 4.34 Luck.
* This trinket can be dropped whenever the active item needs recharging, then picked up again once the item is fully charged. For active items that aren't used every time they're recharged (such as the D6), using the trinket this way can generate many free batteries each floor.

* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}} / {{i|120 Volt}}: Allows zaps to arc on the same enemy multiple times.
* {{I|Options?}}: Also offers alternate rewards for the extra batteries.

* If Rib of Greed is picked up after a Greed fight in a {{R|Shop}} or a {{R|Secret Room}}, reentering the room will turn the room into a regular shop with items for sale or a secret room respectively (while keeping the previously dropped items on the floor).
** By dropping the Rib of Greed before entering a shop, fighting Greed, then picking up the trinket again, the shop can be accessed while also having made free money from the Greed fight.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Also increases chance of {{e|Double Penny||double pennies}}, {{e|Nickel||nickels}}, {{e|Dime||dimes}}, {{e|Lucky Penny||lucky pennies}}, and {{e|Golden Penny|n|golden pennies}} drops.

sections.Effects: * Upon entering a room with enemies for the first time, spawns a [[Familiars#Locusts|Red Locust]] which detonates upon impact with enemies, dealing double tear damage for the impact of the Locust and 60 damage for the explosion.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|War}}.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc|r}} Explosive locusts have a larger aggro range than all other locusts. They will target an enemy from further away.
* {{dlc|nr}} This trinket can be dangerous to hold, as the locust will instantly target the nearest enemy as Isaac enters the room, which can be close enough to catch Isaac in its blast radius.
** {{dlc|r}} The explosion from the locust is very small, on scale of a single tile, but can still hurt Isaac.
* The Locust will also spawn each time a wave starts in {{R|Boss Rush}} and {{dlc|r+}} {{mode|greed|greedier}} [[Greed Mode]].
* The explosion takes most bomb effects from items that Isaac has, with some exceptions.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Each copy will spawn one more locust.
* {{I|Bomber Boy|r}}: Additional smaller explosions will spawn in a tight cross formation.
* {{I|Brimstone Bombs}}: The locust explosions fires thinner beams, dealing 4.8 damage per tick.
* {{I|Glitter Bombs|r}}: Locust explosions have a chance to spawn pickups or trinkets.
* {{I|Hive Mind}}: The locusts’ impact damage is doubled and the explosion damage is increased to 85.
* {{I|Sad Bombs}}: A ring of 10 tears is shot outward upon detonation, which are affected by Isaac's tear modifiers, and deal damage equal to 15 + 0.6x, where x is Isaac's Damage.
sections.Interactions:

* {{I|Ghost Bombs}}: No ghost is spawned.
* {{I|Glitter Bombs|nr}}: Pickups and trinkets will not spawn from locust explosions.
* {{I|Mr. Mega}}: No additional explosion damage or radius.
* {{I|Scatter Bombs|n}}: Mini bombs are not spawned.
* {{I|Sticky Bombs}}: No spiders are spawned on enemy death.

'''Petrified Poop''' is a [[Trinkets|trinket]] that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance to drop from {{g|Poop}}.

sections.Effects: * Increases [[pickup]] drop rate from poops to 50%.
sections.Notes:
* Can be used when fighting bosses that spawn poop like {{E|Larry Jr.}} or {{E|Dingle}}, although the drop rate is greatly decreased in these rooms.
* Not affected by [[Luck]].
* If obtained during the {{e|Mother's Shadow|n}} chase, the trinket will not spawn pickups from destroyed poops.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|E. Coli|a+}}/{{i|Flush!|n}}: Grants poops made from enemies a chance to drop pickups.
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{I|Mom's Box}}: Having one of these increases the chance to 60%. {{dlc|r}} Each copy further increases the chance for poops to drop pickups.
* Very effective with {{p|A Card Against Humanity}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|E. Coli|na+}}/{{i|Flush!|n}}: Poops made from enemies do not drop pickups.
* {{i|IBS}}/{{C|Tainted ???}}: No effect on thrown poops.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr+}} Increases the chance to have an {{R|Angel Room}} replace a {{R|Devil Room}}, from 50% (base chance) to 75%.
* {{dlc|r+}} Guarantees Angel Rooms instead of Devil Rooms, whenever one would spawn.
* Increases the chance to find {{I|The Bible}} to 45% in the {{R|Library}} and in the {{R|Shop}} to 13%.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/bindingofisaac/comments/3q85fv/rnjesus_secrets_behind_pedestal_item_generation/</ref>
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r}}: Future items in all item pools have a chance to be replaced by a {{i|Rosary}} while the trinket is held.
** One boost results in a <math display="inline">\frac{4}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight}}</math> chance, and both boosts results in a <math display="inline">\frac{6}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight}}</math> chance.
** The above means Rosaries are much more easily found in smaller pools. As an example, the chance for a replacement in the {{ip|Treasure Room|text=Treasure item pool}} is on the order of 1%, but for the {{ip|Planetarium|dlc=n}} they can be as high as ~36% or ~55% depending on the number of boosts.
** The replaced items will count as seen, which may result in them never being available again depending on the item pool.
** Picking up a Rosary will not remove the chance of finding more.
** {{dlc|r+}} Increases Angel Room chance by 5%. Having both increases it by 10%.
sections.Notes:
* {{Dlc|nr+}}The increased chance will not allow Angel Rooms to appear before [[Chapter 2]].
* {{dlc|rnr+}} Due to an Angel Room being guaranteed after skipping the first Devil Deal, Rosary Bead only increases in usefulness after the first Angel Room has been encountered.
* If a {{Dlc|nr+}} Devil, {{Dlc|nr}} {{R|Black Market}}, or {{i|Satanic Bible|rnr+}} deal has been paid, an Angel Room will not spawn, even with Rosary Bead.
** {{dlc+|r}} An Angel Room can still spawn if Isaac has {{i|Act of Contrition}} or {{i|Book of Virtues}}.{{dlc-}}
* Unlike {{I|Goat Head}} or {{I|The Book of Belial}}, this trinket does not increase the chance for an Angel/Devil Room Door to spawn when a Boss is killed. It only increases the chance for it to be an Angel room '''if''' it does appear.

sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either increases the chance of changing the room drop reward to a {{e|Key||Key}} to 20% and increases the chance of adding a key to rewards to 66%. Having both increases these chances to respectively 30% and 100%.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns pickups left on the previous floor in the starting room of the current floor.
** A maximum of 4 pickups can be spawned.
sections.Notes:
* The "previous floor" status of trinkets can be reset by picking them up and dropping them again, allowing multiple other trinkets to be carried between floors.
* If pickups were transported to another floor from the Treasure or Boss Room, their copies will remain in those rooms and can be encountered during the [[Ascent]].
** Affected trinkets still transform into {{P|Cracked Key}}s, potentially allowing you to gain large amounts of Cracked Keys.
* Spawns pickups on the first floor if {{I|R Key}} was used.
* Does not bring pickups from {{r|I AM ERROR}} rooms.
* May spawn {{i|Broken Shovel 1|n}} on the next floor if it was knocked down but not taken.
* [[Rooms|Special Rooms]]  take priority, in a certain order, over normal rooms, with {{r|Boss Rooms}} having the highest priority.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}} / {{t|Myosotis|r+}}: Each copy increases the amount of pickups spawned by 2, up to a maximum of 8 pickups spawned per floor.

sections.Effects:
* Gives +10 [[luck]].
* This trinket is destroyed if Isaac takes non-self damage while holding it (i.e. getting hit by [[Monsters]], walking on [[Spikes]], getting hit by an explosion, etc.).
sections.Notes:
* This trinket can only be obtained by clearing 3 consecutive floors without taking damage. It will drop upon the final boss room of said consecutive floors being cleared.
** In [[Greed Mode]], it will drop after defeating the first boss of the third floor ({{s|Depths}} / {{s|Necropolis}} / {{s|Dank Depths}}).
** While playing co-op, everyone needs to play without taking damage for the trinket to spawn.
* {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, {{e|Hell Game}}s, {{e|Confessional}}s, {{R|Curse Room}}s, {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s, {{E|Spiked Chest}}s, [[Bad Trip]] pills, {{E|White Fire Place}}s and the door to {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}} count as self-damage and won't destroy Perfection.
* Every XL floor cleared counts as a single floor for the purposes of obtaining this trinket.
* Perfection can intentionally be dropped if Isaac must take damage for whatever reason, allowing him to keep it.
* Due to the unique method of obtaining it, Perfection can never naturally spawn as a {{A|Golden Trinket}}.
* 10 Luck is coincidentally the highest amount of luck Isaac can have that would help with [[Room Clear Awards|room clear rewards]] paying out.
* If Isaac holds multiple copies of Perfection via {{i|Mom's Purse}} or {{i|Belly Button}}, upon taking a hit only one of them will get destroyed.
* {{dlc|nr+}} Damage taken by {{T|Found Soul}}, {{I|Lost Soul}}, {{i|Strawman}} and {{p|Soul of the Forgotten}} will reset cleared floors count, thus Perfection will not drop. However, Perfection itself will not be destroyed if they take damage.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blanket}} / {{i|Dogma}} / {{p|Holy Card}} / {{i|Holy Mantle}} / {{c|The Lost}} / {{p|Soul of the Lost}} / {{E|White Fire Place}}s / {{t|Wooden Cross}}: Losing the shield does not destroy Perfection.
* {{I|Blood Oath}} / {{i|Dull Razor}} / {{i|Sharp Plug}} / {{i|IV Bag}}: Does not destroy Perfection, nor does it prevent its acquisition.
* {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: Makes it much easier to hold on to Perfection since, as long as it can be used in the room where you take damage before you leave, Isaac can reset to the previous room with the trinket intact.
* {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: Since these characters are likely to die instantly after taking a single hit, Perfection is almost guaranteed to drop after the third floor boss room is cleared and is also almost guaranteed to stay with them until their deaths.
** This means getting [[Luck#Effects of Luck|luck based items]] at any point of the run, especially ones with luck scaling that tops out at about 10 luck, is a very good idea.
** The ability to [[Smelter|Smelt]]/[[Pills#Gulp!|Gulp]] trinkets will also add to the synergy, as there are many luck-based trinkets as well.
* {{i|Rock Bottom}}: The +10 luck persists after switching trinkets as stats are locked to their highest values ever reached after picking Rock Bottom up. However, after losing Perfection, additional luck-ups will have no effect until the luck bonus lost is made up. (The stats are still being calculated behind the scenes, but until it surpasses the run's post-rock-bottom luck record, the record will be used instead).
sections.Interactions: * [[Gulp!]] / {{i|Marbles}} / {{i|Smelter}}: Despite being added to the inventory, it will still be destroyed at the next damage taken.

sections.Effects: * Has a 25% chance to grant the effects of a random passive [[Item Tags mom#Passive Collectibles|Mom item]] each room.
sections.Notes:
* The trinket can't give the effect of {{i|Mom's Coin Purse}} or {{i|Mom's Purse}}.
* The trinket can give the effect of a Mom item Isaac already has.
* Mom's Lock doesn't count towards {{tf|Yes Mother?}}, no matter the effect.
* The items chosen by the trinket won't grant [[health]] or spawn [[pickup]]s/consumables.
sections.Synergies: * {{a|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: Each copy increases the chance for activation to 50%, further copies to 100%.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac's tears travel in a high-speed spiral pattern.
* {{dlc|r}} Also grants +0.4 [[Tears]] and [[spectral tears]].
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Pin}}, {{e|Larry Jr.}}, {{e|The Hollow}} or {{e|Scolex}}.{{dlc-}}
* The tear pattern slightly increases Isaac's effective range.
* {{dlc|nr}} The trinket has no effect on any non-tear based attack, such as {{i|Brimstone}} or {{i|Mom's Knife}}.
** {{dlc|r}} The trinket now affects all tear/non-tear modifiers, with the only exceptions being {{I|Dr. Fetus}}, {{I|Epic Fetus}} and {{I|Tech X|n}}, which don't work.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}}/{{I|Mom's Box|r}}: In addition to the further stat increase, each copy makes the spiral path larger.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Backstabber}}: Due to the unusual tear travel, Ring Worm may be used to hit enemies in the back, without having the need to be placed behind them.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: The altered pattern tears travel in is confined to the beam.
** {{dlc|r}} Isaac can benefit from Ring Worm's stat bonus and spectral tears without losing accuracy.

sections.Effects:
* Increases {{r|Devil Room}} chance by 10%.
* Prevents {{E|Krampus}} from appearing in the Devil Deal.
* If held before visiting the Devil Deal, the room's layout will be replaced with one of 12 special Devil Room layouts (7 in [[Greed Mode]]). These rooms contain 0-3 Devil Room items (most commonly 2-3), 1-3 {{E|Black Heart}}s, and several enemies from {{s|Sheol}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{dlc|r+}} {{A|Golden Trinket|n}} / {{I|Mom's Box|n}}: Adds 5% to the devil room chance per copy.

sections.Effects: * Adds a chance to shoot a [[Status Effects#Effects|poison tear]], dealing damage over time when inflicted
sections.Notes:
* The chance to fire a poison tear depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: <math>\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5  \right \rfloor}</math>
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 20% and having both to 33%.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|The Common Cold}}: Activation rates are individually applied to each tear, effectively allowing for higher amounts of poison tears. However at 12 Luck, this trinket will not do anything for Isaac as The Common Cold is guaranteed to make every tear poisoned at that point.

sections.Effects: * Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns 1-4 [[Familiars#Locusts|White Locusts]] that deal double Isaac's damage.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Conquest}}.{{dlc-}}
* The Locust will also spawn each time a wave starts in {{R|Boss Rush}} and {{dlc|r+}} {{mode|greed|greedier}} [[Greed Mode]].
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either spawns 2-5 locusts. Having both spawns 3-7 locusts.

sections.Effects: * A {{e|Shop Restock Machine}} always spawns in {{R|Treasure Room}}s.
sections.Notes:
* The trinket's effect applies when the floor is generated, so it will only take effect if already held when entering a new floor. This means that finding it on a floor will not change the Treasure Room on that floor, nor will dropping it remove its effect on that floor's Treasure Room if Pay to Win was held when the floor was entered.
** {{dlc|r}} This also means that the trinket will have no effect in the [[Ascent]], since it is based on previously generated floors.
* This trinket does not affect the two Treasure Rooms spawned in {{s|???}}.
* In [[Greed Mode]], this affects both normal and silver types of Treasure Rooms.
* {{dlc|r}} When brought to the alternate path floors, there is a chance of the treasure room having one extra item available to be picked up alongside the usual choice of two items.
* {{dlc|r}} Restock boxes will not appear in the [[Mirrored World|Mirrored World's]] Treasure Room.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: The chance for Restock Machine blowing up after 4 rerolls is 1 / (1 + number of copies).
* {{I|Bag of Crafting}}: Can be a powerful combination for when Isaac is not {{C|Tainted Cain}} as he can craft multiple item pedestals in the {{r|Treasure Room}} which can be rerolled.
* {{i|More Options}}: {{r|Treasure Room}}s will always contain two choice items in addition to the {{e|Shop Restock Machine}}.
** {{dlc+|r}} In {{s|Downpour}}, {{s|Dross}}, and {{s|Mines}}, Pay to Win by itself can sometimes spawn the combined Treasure Rooms, even without More Options. Having both doesn't guarantee the combined effect.
*** For {{s|Ashpit}}, {{s|Mausoleum}}, {{s|Gehenna}}, and {{s|Corpse}}, this combination does work correctly for normal-sized Treasure Rooms, but not thin ones.{{dlc-}}

sections.Effects: * Spawns a [[Blue Fly]] every time a [[coin]] is picked up.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Spawns one more blue fly per copy.

sections.Effects:
* Doubles the chance for [[Monsters#Champions|champion enemies]] to appear.
* Also increases the chance of encountering champion [[boss]]es.
* {{dlc|r+}} The chance for champion enemies to drop special or double loot is increased to 50%.
sections.Notes:
* The increased number of Champions means that more enemies will drop additional loot, which can be useful when low on keys or bombs.
* The chance to spawn a champion in Normal is very low (5%), {{dlc|nr+}} and the drop chance for additional loot in Hard mode is only 33%, making this trinket very rarely worth keeping.
* {{dlc|a}} Since champions don't drop any consumables in [[Greed Mode]], this trinket only has a downside in this mode.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Mom's Box|r}} / {{a|Golden Trinket}}: Each copy of Purple Heart increases the multiplier by 2 (e.g. 6x with 3 Purple Hearts, 20x with 10 Purple Hearts).
** {{i|Mom's Box|r+}} / {{a|Golden Trinket|r+}}: Having either increases the chance of special or double loot to 66%. Having both to 75%.

sections.Effects:
* If a {{E|Chest}} would contain {{e|Red Heart|text=Hearts}}, {{e|Penny|text=Coins}}, {{e|Bomb}}s, or {{e|Key}}s and [[pills]], [[Cards and Runes|cards, or runes]] (for {{e|Wooden Chest}}s), it has a 50/50 chance to either drop extra consumables or replace all of its contents with an {{E|Attack Fly}}.
** The affected chests include:
*** {{E|Chest}}s
*** {{e|Locked Chest}}s
*** {{e|Bomb Chest}}s
*** {{e|Eternal Chest}}s
*** {{e|Spiked Chest}}s
*** {{e|Mimic Chest}}s
*** {{e|Mega Chest}}s
*** {{e|Haunted Chest}}s
*** {{e|Wooden Chest}}s
** This excludes:
*** {{e|Red Chest}}s
*** {{e|Old Chest}}s
*** {{e|Mom's Chest}}
* Consequently, Poker Chip has no effect in {{s|Chest}} or {{s|Dark Room}}.
* {{dlc|r}} If opening a {{E|Mega Chest|n}} yields pickups, it can spawn 1-2 Attack Flies alongside the pickups.
* {{dlc|r+}} If the chest would contain an item of [[quality]] 0-2, it is rechosen to get a +1 quality bonus.
** If there are no suitable replacement items remaining in the {{ip|Golden Chest}} pool, the {{ip|Treasure Room}} pool can be used instead.
** The quality improvement is not applied in Chest or Dark Room.
* {{dlc|r+}} Slightly increases the payout chance from {{e|Slot Machine}}s, {{e|Fortune Telling Machine}}s, {{e|Crane Game}}s, {{e|Shell Game}}s and {{e|Shop Restock Machine}}s.
sections.Notes: * The effect of Poker Chip does not trigger when it's picked up, nor does it deactivate when it's dropped. Rather, Isaac must leave and re-enter a room for a chest's contents to update.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either doubles gambling payouts. Having both triples them.
* {{I|Guppy's Eye}}: Provided that the Poker Chip is not smelted, it can be used in conjunction with the eye to open all chests with extra pickups, while dropping the chip for any chests containing flies, nullifying the downside of the trinket.
* {{i|Sharp Key}}: Enemies killed by keys have a 50/50 chance to spawn extra pickups or an {{E|Attack Fly}}; the attack fly will be instantly killed by the thrown key.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a {{e|Half Red Heart}} each time a {{e|Key}} is used to unlock a door, {{E|Locked Chest}}, or key block.
* Turns {{e|Half Red Heart}} pickups into {{e|Red Heart}}s. Half hearts already on the ground will also be upgraded upon re-entering the room.
sections.Notes:
* Having Mom's Locket while playing {{C|Keeper}} or {{C|Tainted Keeper|r}} will restore a full health coin when a key is used.
* Donating keys to a {{e|Key Master}} won't heal Isaac.
* A very useful trinket for unlocking the {{A|It's the Key}} achievement, in which Isaac cannot pick up coins, bombs, and most importantly, hearts.
* {{c|Tainted Bethany}} is granted a blood charge upon using a key.
sections.Synergies:
* {{T|Equality!|nr+}}: As long as Equality is active, ''all'' red hearts will be double.
* {{I|Humbleing Bundle}}: Humbleing Bundle cannot alter half red hearts, but Mom's Locket turns them into full red hearts, which it can double.
* {{i|Hypercoagulation|r}} / {{p|Soul of Magdalene|r}} / {{C|Tainted Magdalene|r}}: Created temporary half hearts are now full red hearts.
* {{i|Birthright|r}} + {{C|Tainted Eve|r}}: Blood clots drop full hearts rather than half hearts, making it possible to infinitely make two for one.
* {{I|The Jar}}: Any half red hearts stored by The Jar will be converted to full hearts when dropped on the ground. Since The Jar will store any leftover health from healing Red Heart Containers, this can allow for potentially infinite health when healing half-empty containers. Especially effective in conjunction with {{I|Cancer}} or {{I|The Wafer}}.
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either now grants a {{e|Red Heart}} when using a key. Having both grants 1 and a half heart.
sections.Interactions: * {{e|Golden Key}} / {{i|Pay To Play}} / {{t|Paper Clip}} / {{t|Blue Key}}: Renders Mom's Locket less effective, as the trinket requires a key to be consumed by the lock in order to heal Isaac.

sections.Effects: * Tears pulsate in size between 1x to 1.6x as they travel. The effect changes the hitbox of the tear but does not affect damage.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating {{e|Pin}}, {{e|Larry Jr.}}, {{e|The Hollow}} or {{e|Scolex}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r}}: Each copy multiplies the maximum tear size.
* {{i|Godhead}}: The damaging aura pulses along with the tear.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac has a chance to fart or poop every 30 seconds. {{dlc|nr}} Getting hit can also trigger the effect.
* {{dlc|r}} Farts deal 6 damage and blow away projectiles.
sections.Notes:
* With smart positioning, poops can be placed and bombed to create bridges for 1 tile gaps, allowing Isaac to reach otherwise unobtainable consumables.
* Isaac can poop as much as he wants without leaving the room, but he still cannot poop where a previous poop was placed or destroyed.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}}: Spawned poop is golden.
* {{T|Brown Cap}}: Poops may be used to access secret rooms and blow rocks and debris.
** + {{tf|Yes Mother?}}: Not recommended. Poops will blow up as soon as they spawn.
** + {{I|Pyromaniac}}: Provides a slow, but effective source of healing.
* {{T|Butt Penny}} / {{T|Petrified Poop}} : Poops are more likely to drop pickups, allowing to farm them over time.
* {{I|Dirty Mind}}: Allows a steady supply of Dips, with time. Useful for later chapters.
* {{T|Gigante Bean}}: Farts are affected, covering a wide area and dealing 10 damage instead.
* {{T|Meconium}}: Poops spawned by Mysterious Candy have a chance to be black poop.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Hallowed Ground}} / {{I|Midas' Touch}}: The spawned poops are not affected by these items.

sections.Effects:
* Allows Isaac to unlock {{E|Locked Chest}}s without using {{E|Key}}s.
** Locked doors, key blocks, and {{E|Mega Chest}}s still require keys.
sections.Notes:
* In addition to regular trinket drop sources, Paper Clip can be obtained as a possible reward from {{e|Key Master}}s.
* {{dlc|a}} {{c|Cain}} starts with this trinket after donating 68 coins to the {{e|Greed Donation Machine}}.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Allows to open locked blocks without using a key. 
** Additionally allows to open locked doors without using a key if Isaac has both {{A|Golden Trinket|n}} and {{i|Mom's Box|n}}.
* {{I|Pay To Play|r}}: Golden Chests no longer cost a coin to open.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Mom's Locket|a}}: Renders Mom's Locket less effective as the trinket requires a key to be consumed by the lock in order to heal Isaac.

sections.Effects:
* Occasionally spawns a [[blue spider|Blue Spider]].
** Effect only occurs when in an uncleared room.
** After the first spider spawns, there is a 50% chance of one spawning after 30 seconds and a guaranteed spawn a minute later.
* {{dlc|r+}} Spawns a [[blue spider|Blue Spider]] when completing a combat room.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}} / {{t|Louse|r}} : Each copy of the effect will spawn an additional spider every time one is spawned.

sections.Effects: * Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns a [[Familiars#Locusts|Yellow Locust]] that deals double Isaac's damage and slows enemies.
sections.Notes:

sections.Effects:
