sections.Effects:
* Adds a 10% chance to fire a booger tear that sticks to the first enemy that it comes in contact with and deals damage over time.
** Each booger deals damage equal to Isaac's tear damage every second.
** {{dlc|nr}}The booger lasts for 60 seconds or until the enemy dies.
*** {{dlc|r}}The booger lasts 10 seconds.
* Boogers have a 50% chance of being [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing]].
sections.Notes:
* Not affected by [[Luck]].
* Booger tears cannot pierce through enemies.
* Multiple boogers can stick to one enemy to deal extra damage.
* Nose Goblin's effect is almost identical to {{i|Sinus Infection}} beyond the added homing effect and having half the chance to trigger. Consequently, all its non-homing synergies apply to Nose Goblin.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|r}}{{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|The Ludovico Technique}}/{{i|Tech X}}/{{i|Trisagion}}: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate booger tear on a hit enemy.
* {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Booger tears will split into split booger tears that can attach to enemies.
* {{i|Explosivo}}: Explosivo tears can also be booger tears which damage the enemy over time while stuck to them before exploding.
* {{i|Godhead}}: Shots retain their aura while stuck to an enemy, but the aura can damage only enemies other than the booger victim. If the enemy dies before the booger’s maximum duration, it will resume homing and will often stick to a second enemy.
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either raises the chance to fire a booger tear to 20% chance and to 75% the chance for it to be [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing]]. Having both raises the chance to respectively 30% and 100%.
* {{tf|Guppy}}: Damage instances from boogers attached to enemies have a 100% ({{dlc|r}} 50%) chance to spawn a [[Blue Fly]].
* {{i|Lachryphagy|nr}}: All tears have a chance to burst into boogers. Boogers will always burst into more boogers, though some of the boogers may incorrectly appear to be normal tears. When a booger sticks to an enemy, it will burst into 8 boogers which have a high chance of sticking again to the same enemy.
* {{i|Lost Contact}}: Boogers that stick to enemies will block shots, and will not be destroyed in the process.
* {{i|Polyphemus}}: Booger shots lose the Polyphemus pierce effect, but stick to enemies while dealing the full damage of the Polyphemus shot. Damage does not degrade.
* {{i|Sinus Infection}}: The 50% homing also applies to boogers fired by Sinus Infection.
* {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Swings and projectiles have a chance to apply boogers on enemies.
* {{i|Strange Attractor}}: Attraction effect will remain on the booger shot stuck to an enemy. This can drag the enemy across the whole room until they reach one wall and get stuck on it, effectively disabling their normal movement.
* {{i|Tech.5|r}}: The laser also has a chance to apply boogers on enemies.
* {{i|Technology|r}}: Hit enemies have a chance for a booger to be applied to them.
* {{i|Technology 2|r}}: The laser can also apply boogers with the laser’s chance to apply boogers being determined rapidly every tick.
* {{i|Technology Zero}}: Boogers can be connected with electricity while being attached dealing large amounts of damage to the booger victim.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Tech X}}/{{i|Trisagion}}/{{i|Ipecac}}: Overrides Nose Goblin.
** {{i|Ipecac}}: Booger tears will still appear, but will act identically to other Ipecac shots.
* {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Booger tears will not split after killing enemies.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}: Overrides Nose Goblin.
* {{i|Holy Light}}: Holy light strikes do not activate on booger shots.
* {{I|Immaculate Heart}}/{{I|Saturnus|n}}: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
* {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: Lightning strikes do not activate on booger shots.
* {{Dlc|nr}} {{i|Tech.5}}/{{I|Technology 2}}: The laser is unaffected by Nose Goblin.
* {{dlc|nr}}{{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The large tear has a chance to stick to enemies. The tear cannot be controlled while it is stuck to an enemy, and cannot be removed until the enemy has died.

sections.Effects:
* Tears travel in a large spiral pattern.
* Grants [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral tears]].
* {{dlc|nr}} +4.0 [[range]], +2.0 [[tear falling speed]].
* {{dlc|r}} +1.5 [[range]], +0.4 [[tears]].
* A [[luck]]-based chance for a [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing]] shot, reaching 100% at 9 luck.
** The homing shots are not different in appearance.
** The homing does not override the spiral pattern, meaning tears stay unreliable.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Mom's Box|nr}}: Doubles the range increase.
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r}}: Having either makes the spiral pattern larger and doubles the stat increase. Having both makes the pattern even larger and triples the stat increase.
* {{I|Aquarius|r}}: Creep has a chance to be homing.
* {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Since the bombs don't follow the spiral pattern, only the extra range, spectral bombs, and chance for a homing bomb apply.
* {{i|Tractor Beam}}: The tears follow a straight path, ignoring the spiral pattern; the tears also stall at a specific point, giving a greater chance to land tears.
sections.Interactions:
* {{dlc|nr}} {{c|Azazel}} / {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: The spiral effect is overidden. All other effects still apply.
** {{dlc|r}} The laser is shot in a spiral pattern. Homing does take effect, but is hardly noticeable.
* {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear spirals around in a difficult to control manner, with the added homing chance further complicating things.
* {{i|Mom's Knife|nr}}: Overrides Ouroboros Worm.
** {{dlc|r}} Works as intended. The homing, however, is questionable.
* {{I|Proptosis}}: The curious pattern allows dealing full damage from a safer range.
* {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: His Brimstone laser is shot in a spiral pattern. Homing does take effect, but is hardly noticeable.
* {{i|Tech X|nr}}: Overrides Ouroboros Worm.
** {{dlc|r}} Tech X now inherits the homing chance benefit, without being affected by the pattern.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|nr}} [[Rocks]] and their variants drop 1 {{e|Penny}} when destroyed.
* {{dlc|r}} [[Rocks]] and their variants have a 33% chance to drop 1 {{e|Penny}} when destroyed.
sections.Synergies:
* {{dlc|rnr+}} {{A|Golden Trinket|n}} / {{i|Mom's Box|n}}: Chance for rocks to drop pennies is multiplied.
** {{dlc|r+}} Having either has the same chance to drop 2 pennies at once. Having both the same chance to drop 3 pennies at once.
sections.Notes:
* The spawned coin is always a regular penny; it cannot be a (sticky) {{E|Nickel}}, {{E|Dime}}, or {{E|Lucky Penny}}.
* Coins from obstacles are dropped from any source that destroys them, including enemies such as the {{E|Roundy}}.

sections.Effects:
* Activates Isaac's active item just before damage would be taken.
** This still uses the item's charges, so if the item is not charged, the trinket will do nothing.
** Single-use items will be consumed.
sections.Notes:
* Panic Button will attempt to use the item 2-3 times per tick as damage is incoming. This may cause some unlimited use items to trigger multiple times before one damage instance.
* Some items will be activated after respawning if Isaac is killed by the incoming damage, including {{I|Guppy's Paw}} and {{I|Mega Blast}}.
* Taking damage from explosions, enemy creep, spikes and spike rocks, {{E|Spiked Chest}} and {{E|Mimic Chest}}, some attack from above (for example, the stomp attacks from {{E|Mom}} and {{E|Satan}}), {{E|Whipper}} and their variants, brimstone lasers (including angel lasers), or electric lasers, will not trigger the effect as those are instantaneous.
* Self-damage sources also won't trigger the trinket. This includes items, machines, and damaging doors.
* Does not activate items in a consumable slot (such as {{c|Tainted Bethany}}'s {{i|Lemegeton}} or dice items granted by {{t|Dice Bag}}).
* Will activate when touching {{E|Dark Esau}} while playing as {{C|Tainted Jacob}}, despite Dark Esau not technically dealing damage.
** This effect still occurs even whilst he is chained by {{I|Anima Sola}}, when he deals no contact damage.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either gives 10% chance to not deplete the item's charge when it's activated. Having both increases the chance to 20%.
sections.Interactions:
* Any self-damaging item: Self-damage occurs before enemy damage, making it almost impossible to lose Devil/Angel Room chances.
** For self-damaging items that deals only half a heart damage (such as {{i|Kamikaze!}}), before chapter 4, it will also reduce enemy damage to half a heart, similarly to {{i|The Wafer}}.
* {{i|Blank Card}} with {{P|VII - The Chariot}} / {{P|VII - The Chariot?}}: Activate their respective effects without consuming it.
* {{i|Blood Rights}}: Triggers the effect on hit, at the cost of a full-heart of damage on the first hit and half-heart damage on subsequent hits in the same room.
* {{I|Book of Shadows}}: Activates the item, giving Isaac the [[shield]] effect for 10 seconds.
* {{i|Bursting Sack}}: Even though the neutral spiders can't possibly hurt Isaac, the trinket still activates when contact is made with them.
* {{i|Butter Bean}} / {{i|Wait What?}}: Isaac farts before being hit, knocking back enemies and projectiles.
* {{i|Clear Rune}} with {{P|Algiz}} / {{P|Blank Rune}} / {{P|Rune Shard}} / {{P|Soul of Judas}}: Activate their respective effects without consuming it.
* {{I|Dark Arts}}: Unlike many other items on this list, Dark Arts can be used to negate damage more than once per room, making it an excellent defensive item to use with Panic Button. Note that this does '''not''' work while playing as{{C|Tainted Judas}}.
* {{i|Damocles}}: '''Not recommended.''' Damocles will activate right before Isaac takes damage, guaranteeing Damocles will fall later in the run.
* {{i|Dull Razor}}: Activates the item and gives Isaac invincibility frames before being hit. If combined with {{i|9 Volt}} or {{t|AAA Battery}}, works every room, just like Holy Mantle. If combined with {{i|The Battery}}, {{i|Habit}}, and {{i|Car Battery}} it will make Isaac almost invincible.
* {{I|Glowing Hourglass}}: Rewind time to the previous room.
* {{i|Holy Mantle}}: Does ''not'' stop the trinket from activating.
** {{C|The Lost}} can die this way should he carry self-damaging items at the time of the hit.
* {{i|How to Jump}}: Makes Isaac immune to contact and tear damage while moving.
* {{i|IV Bag}}: Upon getting hit, activates the IV Bag instead, causing self-damage and producing money.
* {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Causes a highly-damaging explosion to occur every time Isaac is hit.
* {{i|My Little Unicorn}}: Gives [[invulnerability]] and +0.28 [[speed]] for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.
* {{i|Razor Blade}}: Isaac gains a damage boost every time he's hit, acting similarly to {{T|Red Patch}}, at the cost of a full-heart of damage on the first hit and half-heart damage on subsequent hits in the same room.
* {{i|Stitches}}: Isaac will teleport before damage is taken, making him much harder to hit.
* {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Triggers his active item whenever the body touches something that would damage the {{c|Tainted Soul}}, regardless of damage taken.
* {{i|Suplex!}}: As long as Suplex! is fully charged, damage can be dodged by the grab.
* {{i|Telekinesis}}: Automatically blocks any incoming shots, but the push is not strong enough to prevent contact damage.
* {{I|The Gamekid}}: Turns the character into a Pac-Man-like creature for 6.5 seconds and provides [[invulnerability]], inflicts [[fear]] on all enemies, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.
* {{i|Unicorn Stump}}: Gives [[invulnerability]] and +0.28 [[speed]] for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears while the effect is active.

sections.Effects:
* Grants a chance of increasing [[damage]] by 1.8 for the current room upon taking damage.
** The chance depends on the [[luck]] stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: {{dlc|nr+}} <math>\frac1 { 5 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck}  \times 0.5\right \rfloor}</math>
*** At 0 luck the chance is 20%, maxing out at 100% at {{dlc|nr+}} 8 / {{dlc|r+}} 16 luck.
sections.Notes: * Can trigger multiple times in the same room and stack with itself or {{i|Razor Blade}}, which provides a similar effect.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 33% and having both to 50%.

sections.Effects: * Spawns a {{E|Grab Bag}} upon traveling to the next floor.
sections.Synergies:
* {{T|Found Soul}}: An extra sack will spawn next to Found Soul.
* {{A|Golden Trinket}}/{{I|Mom's Box}}: Grants 1 extra sack every floor per copy.
sections.Interactions:

sections.Effects:
* Instead of trailing behind Isaac, [[familiar]]s are directly controlled by the same inputs as Isaac's.
* Holding the drop button will allow Isaac to move while keeping the familiars in place, identical to {{c|Jacob and Esau}}.
sections.Notes:
* This trinket affects the same familiars {{I|King Baby}} effects. For a list of the familiars unaffected by this trinket, visit King Baby's page.
* [[Familiar#Throwable familiars|Throwable familiars]] do not return to Isaac upon impact; instead, they treat their impact location as their new "launch" location, and can be fired in any direction from there. The only exception is {{I|Jaw Bone}} which will return to the location it was launched from.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Familiars gain contact damage, dealing 2 damage per tick (about 8.6 damage per second). Having both increases the damage to 5 per tick (about 21.4 damage per second).
* {{t|Friendship Necklace}} + {{i|Spin to Win}}: Familiars affected by Friendship Necklace are still considered orbitals regardless of positioning allowing Isaac to use their contact damage without getting close to enemies. RC Remote also prevents familiars that weren't already orbitals from flashing when Spin to Win is used despite still being affected by the active item.
* {{I|King Baby}}: Familiars are not held in place while firing but still auto-target enemies.
* {{c|Lilith}}: {{i|Incubus}} can be positioned on top of Lilith, effectively removing Lilith's downside.
* {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Familiars will move with Tainted Soul, and not follow behind Tainted Forgotten like they normally do. This is massively beneficial as it allows Tainted Soul to have actual protection against enemies. Orbitals still remain orbiting Tainted Forgotten as expected.

sections.Effects:
* {{dlc|na}} If Isaac dies to a {{r|Sacrifice Room}}'s spikes, a puzzle piece will appear on his [[Isaac's last will|last will]].
* {{dlc|a}} Dying in a {{r|Sacrifice Room}} while holding the trinket consumes it, revives Isaac as {{c|The Lost}} and unlocks the character.
** If The Lost is already unlocked, the trinket works outside Sacrifice Rooms as well, reviving Isaac as The Lost.
* {{dlc|r+}} Adds a 1/3 chance to reveal a super secret room upon entering a new floor.
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} None of the effects will occur during any [[Challenges]].
** {{dlc|r+}} This trinket can no longer spawn in challenges.
* {{dlc|anr}} Resurrection items activate in a [[:Category:Revival items|set order]]. Missing Poster has the lowest priority of all / {{dlc|r}} the second-lowest priority of all, with only {{c|Tainted Lost}}'s {{i|Birthright|n}} effect being lower.
** If another resurrection item activates before Missing Poster while in the sacrifice room, then the player will not become The Lost, but The Lost will still be unlocked. Missing Poster will also not get used up by this.
* {{dlc|anr}} The Lost's intrinsic {{i|Holy Mantle}} is not gained when revived into this way.
** {{dlc|r}} If unlocked, The Lost will have his intrinsic {{i|Holy Mantle}} when revived into this way.
* {{dlc|a}} Dying to {{r|Sacrifice Room}} ''spikes'' specifically is not required to unlock The Lost, and any death within the room counts.
** If Isaac teleports out of the room before dying, i.e. is teleported by the spikes to {{s|Dark Room}}, The Lost will not be unlocked.
** {{dlc|r}} Doesn't unlock {{c|The Lost}} in challenges.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either increases the chance to reveal the location of the super secret room upon entering a new floor to 2/3. Having both to 100%.

sections.Interactions:

sections.Effects:
* Grants one [[Hearts#Red Heart Containers|heart container]] while held.
** This heart container will be filled the first time the trinket is picked up.
sections.Notes:
* If the only heart container Isaac has is the one given by Mother's Kiss, the trinket will be destroyed if the heart container is traded/consumed.
** The trinket will get destroyed even if smelted via {{i|Smelter}}, {{i|Marbles}}, or a [[Pills|Gulp! pill]].
* If Isaac drops the trinket while he only has one heart container for health, he will have no health and die instantly.
** This also means that using {{p|0 - The Fool?}} card will do the same, even if he has soul hearts.
* The extra red heart container can exceed the maximum coin heart container limit of {{c|Keeper}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper}}, allowing them to obtain more than 3 or 2 [[Health#Coin Hearts|coin hearts]], respectively.
* The heart added is a soul heart for {{c|???}} and {{c|Tainted Bethany}}, and a black heart for {{c|Black Judas}} and {{c|Tainted Judas}}.
** Using The Fool? card as one of these characters while holding this trinket will kill you instantly, as it drops the trinket, removing the last half soul heart that you normally would remain with.
* {{c|The Forgotten}} will always get a {{E|Bone Heart}} regardless of whether the body or the soul picked up the trinket.
sections.Synergies:

sections.Effect:
* {{dlc|nr+}} Grants a 10% chance of any non-specific [[Hearts|heart drop]] turning into a {{e|Soul Heart}}.
* {{dlc|r+}} Grants a 10% chance of any non-specific [[Hearts|heart drop]] turning into a {{e|Soul Heart}}, {{e|Black Heart}} or {{e|Bone Heart|n}}.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: This chance is increased to 20%.

sections.Effects:
* Has a 50% chance to mimic the effect of a random [[passive item]] from the current room’s [[Item Pool|item pool]] when entering a room.
** The trinket takes the shape of the mimic item.
sections.Notes: * Modeling Clay can only mimic items that have the "[[Item Tags summonable|summonable]]" item tag, the same way {{I|Lemegeton}} selects the wisps it summons. * The item given by Modeling Clay is seeded and based on the room Isaac is in. * Effects that activate upon pickup will not be applied.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: Increases the chance of triggering to 100%. Having both, or stacking extra copies has no effect.
* {{i|Chaos}}: Removes the item pool constraint for Modeling Clay's available items.
* {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Permanently increases Isaac's stats when it transforms into an item that surpasses Isaac's current stats.
* {{i|Sacred Orb}}: Temporary items are affected by Sacred Orb.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: If Modeling Clay is currently mimicking a viable familiar, it will also be sacrificed and spawn an additional Devil Room item, but Modeling Clay will not be destroyed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{t|Modeling Clay}}: No effect.
* {{i|Magic Skin}}: Modeling Clay can turn into Magic Skin if it was used during the run. Modeling Clay has no effect if this occurs.
* {{i|TMTRAINER}}: Modeling Clay cannot copy glitched items; it will do nothing and not have a sprite if it tries to.

If Modeling Clay mimics the following items, they will behave in the following ways:
* {{i|9 Volt}}: 1-room charge active items will not recharge over time. Other active items are affected normally.
* {{i|Belly Button}} / {{i|Mom's Purse}}: Allows Isaac to hold another trinket alongside Modeling Clay if he picks it up while Modeling Clay mimics the item, and he will continue to hold both even after Modeling Clay changes. If Isaac tries to pick up another trinket while he already has two, it will instead be destroyed and he will only be able to hold one trinket again.
** Isaac can safely exchange cards/pills/trinkets by manually dropping them, at the cost of being unable to hold two.
** Extra trinkets held this way are susceptible to not working properly, if at all.
* {{i|Black Candle}}: Does not remove the current floor’s [[curse]].
* {{i|Bloody Lust}} / {{i|Bloody Gust}} / {{i|False PHD}} / {{i|Keeper's Sack}} / {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Stat boosts will not persist after Modeling Clay changes. If it mimics that item again, it will remember the stat boosts they gave.
* {{i|Blue Map}} / {{i|The Compass}} / {{i|The Mind}} / {{i|Treasure Map}}: Does not reveal rooms on the map.
* {{i|Candy Heart}} / {{i|Soul Locket}}: Stats granted from picking up hearts will not persist after Modeling Clay changes.
* {{i|Cambion Conception}} / {{i|Immaculate Conception}}: If Isaac can somehow meet the requirements for these items to spawn familiars, the familiars will persist for only one room after Modeling Clay changes.
* {{i|Delirious}} / {{i|Mr. ME!}}: Has no effect, even if Isaac uses his active item.
* {{i|Dog Tooth}} / {{i|Spelunker Hat}} / {{i|X-Ray Vision}} / {{i|YO LISTEN!}}: Will reveal/open neighboring [[Secret Room]]s.
* {{i|False PHD}} / {{i|PHD}}: Pills’ effects will be changed, but they will not be identified.
* {{i|GB Bug}}: The familiar respawns every time Isaac re-enters the room where Modeling Clay mimicks GB Bug, allowing for the infinite transformation of pickups.
* {{i|Glitched Crown}}: Items that are spawned while it’s being mimicked will cycle between 5 different items, even after Modeling Clay changes.
* {{i|Missing No.}} / {{i|Isaac's Tomb}} / {{i|Voodoo Head}}: If Isaac can enter a trapdoor to the next floor while it’s being mimicked, they will have their normal effects.
** Other items that activate on floor transition (such as {{i|Dream Catcher}}, {{i|Empty Heart}}, or {{i|Lost Soul}}) will not work.
* {{i|Little Baggy}} / {{i|Polydactyly}} / {{i|Starter Deck}}: Allows Isaac to hold two cards and/or pills if he picks them up while Modeling Clay mimics the item, and he will continue to hold both even after Modeling Clay changes. If Isaac tries to pick up another card/pill after Modeling Clay changes, the inactive card/pill he was holding will be destroyed and he will only be able to hold one card/pill again.
** If Isaac goes to a new room while Modeling Clay mimics Starter Deck/Little Baggy, cards/pills in the new room will be converted appropriately.
* {{i|Member Card}}: The special trapdoor will not spawn.
* {{i|Sanguine Bond}}: The unique spikes will not spawn.
* {{i|Schoolbag}}: If Isaac picks up another active item while Modeling Clay mimics the item, the other active item is dropped after Modeling Clay changes.
sections.Strategy:
Modeling Clay can open additional advantages if a particularly helpful item is chosen for a given room. Exploring all rooms to see what effects are available may be worthwhile to gain the most value of the trinket:
* Explosive shots: Allows Isaac to destroy rocks and open {{R|Secret Room}} doors without spending resources.
* [[:Category:Damage-triggered items|Damage-triggered items]]: To gain extra value from using [[Machines]]/{{e|Beggar}}s that take health or {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s. Note that stats given by on-hit items will not persist outside the rooms they were used in.
** {{i|Hallowed Ground}} can be used first to spawn a white poop next to a Machine/Beggar that takes health to give Isaac the chance to resist damage taken from using them.
* {{i|The Battery}}: Allows Isaac's active item to be overcharged; overcharging will persist after Modeling Clay changes.
* {{i|Cancer}} / {{i|The Wafer}}: Reduces the damage taken from Sacrifice Rooms to half a heart, allowing Isaac to use them more.
* {{i|Echo Chamber}}: Cards and runes’ effects will be stacked if used while it mimics the item. The game will remember what cards and runes were used if it turns into Echo Chamber in the future, even on later floors.
* {{i|Lucky Foot}} / {{i|PHD}} / {{i|Virgo}}: Bad pills will be their good counterparts while mimicking these items, making them much safer to use.
* {{i|Marbles}}: Allows trinkets to be smelted if Isaac can deal damage to himself while it mimics the item.
* {{i|Pyromaniac}}: Lets Isaac heal off explosions in the current room. Can be used to greater effect in rooms with {{g|TNT}} or {{e|Bomb Bum}}s.
* {{i|Restock}}: Items will restock themselves as normal.
* {{i|Scapular}}: To gain a {{E|Soul Heart}} if at low health. This will not work if the damage source is considered "health donation", such as from a {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}, {{e|Devil Beggar}}, {{e|Confessional}}, or {{e|Hell Game}}, but it will work for {{R|Curse Room}}s and {{R|Sacrifice Room}}s.
* {{i|Sharp Plug}}: Isaac’s active item can be instantly recharged at the cost of red hearts.
* {{i|Steam Sale}}: {{R|Shop}} items and pickups will be discounted.
* {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: Cards will have their effects boosted.
** Notable cards are {{P|IX - The Hermit}} for getting rid of [[Greed]] in shops and {{P|XVII - The Stars}} for effectively {{I|More Options}}.

sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either also pulls [[trinket]]s and [[sacks]] toward Isaac. Having both also pulls {{e|Chest}}s.

sections.Effects:
* Upon taking damage, Isaac drops 2 random [[Pickups]] from his inventory (except [[Hearts]], [[Pills]], or [[Cards]]).
* Pickups of higher amounts have more chance to drop.
sections.Notes:
* All pickups are subjected to standard pickup spawn rules, which means that trinket's effect won't necessarily result in a net neutral.

** {{e|Key}}s dropped have a chance of being replaced with {{e|Golden Key}}s or {{E|Charged Key}}s.

* Penny Trinkets : This can be used to generate extra pickups as long as one has a coin.
* {{i|BOGO Bombs}}: Dropped bombs will be their doubled variants.
* {{i|Humbleing Bundle}}: All dropped pickups have a chance to be replaced with doubled variants.
* {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: Grants a chance to drop coins upon taking damage, giving back the lost health.
* {{i|Scapular}}: Can be used to infinitely generate pickups when down to half a Heart by re-entering a room to regenerate a Soul Heart.

sections.Effects:
* Every 15 shots, Isaac will shoot an {{i|Ipecac}} + {{i|My Reflection}} tear with a very high range value.
* The tear will follow Isaac until it hits an enemy or lands, where it will explode.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Each copy reduces the number of shots required to shoot an ipecac tear by 5, with a minimum of 5 shots in between.
* {{I|Pyromaniac}}: Completely negates the downside of Torn Card and will heal you if the shot misses an enemy or wall and hits you instead.
* {{I|Host Hat}}: Completely negates the downside of Torn Card.
* {{I|Almond Milk}} / {{I|Soy Milk}} / {{I|Chocolate Milk}}: Unlike the normal {{I|Ipecac}} synergy, Torn Card shots ignore the damage down multiplier, always dealing +40 damage, '''significantly''' increasing DPS.
* {{T|Brain Worm}}: Brain Worm forces some tears to snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.
* {{I|Death's Touch}} / {{I|Pupula Duplex}}: Ipecac shots get a bigger hitbox, making shots easier to hit, and from a safer distance.
* {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Tear control is stronger than the reflection, although it's still present if Isaac stops shooting. Effectively negates downside.
* {{I|Fire Mind}}: A fire is always spawned at the place of explosion.
* [[Tear Effects|Homing]]: The homing is stronger than the reflection, effectively negating Torn Card's downside.
* {{T|Hook Worm}}: Hook Worm allows tears to hit enemies more easily, while also making them easier to avoid.
* {{I|Lead Pencil}}: Lowers tear shot requirement by 1. Lead Pencil will always proc at the 14th shot, soon followed by Torn Card's at 15th.
* {{I|Monstro's Lung}}: An Ipecac shot is fired for 4 bursts consecutively, with the 5th burst lacking one, and repeat. Makes Torn Card very consistent.
* {{I|Proptosis}}: Ipecac tear will always explode before reflection takes effect. It's the '''only item''' that affects Torn Card's flat 40 damage.
* {{I|Spirit Sword}}: Swings can be spammed rapidly to create Ipecac shots.
* {{I|Tiny Planet}}: Ipecac shots will stick to the orbit and direction Isaac is aiming.
* {{T|Whip Worm}}: Increased shot speed boosts accuracy and the tear is more likely to hit walls if the enemy is missed.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|20/20}} / {{I|Eye Sore}} / {{I|The Inner Eye}} / {{I|Immaculate Heart}} / {{I|Loki's Horns}} / {{I|Mom's Eye}} / {{I|Mutant Spider}} / {{I|The Wiz}}: Extra tears fired do not count towards Torn Card proccing.
* {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Ipecac shots will follow Isaac closely until he stops firing.
* {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Despite replacing tears, Torn Card will still calculate shots required based on Isaac's fire rate. These shots will be fired regardless if the missile crosshair is moving or not.
* {{I|Evil Eye}}: Tears shot by evil eyes cannot fire Ipecac shots, nor count towards proccing.
* {{I|Fate's Reward}}: Cannot proc Torn Card.
* {{I|Incubus}} /  {{I|Twisted Pair}} / {{T|Lil Clot}} / {{T|Found Soul}}: Has its own shot counter, independent of Isaac's. Shots not affected by its damage multiplier, always dealing +40 damage. Shots fired from the Soul will reflect back on itself, rather than Isaac. The Twisted pairs fire an Ipecac shot at the same time.
* {{I|Lachryphagy}}: Ipecac shots become Lachryphagy shots, allowing them to grow. Reflection is weaker due to lower momentum. The burst tears spawned from the tear will all explode.
* {{I|Marked}}: Ipecac shots will be fired from cardinal directions rather than aiming at the crosshair.
* {{T|Second Hand}}: Does not lenghthen the poison effect.

sections.Effects:
* Adds a 50% chance to duplicate one of Isaac's [[familiar]]s when entering a new room.
* If Isaac has no familiars, spawns {{i|Brother Bobby}} or {{i|Sister Maggy}} instead.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket}} / {{I|Mom's Box}} / {{t|The Twins}}: Each copy grants an additional 50% chance to trigger the effect again. This results in another familiar doubling. This can be the same familiar that was doubled originally. The duplication chance of three or more stacks can go above 100% allowing for even more duplicate familiars or {{i|Brother Bobby}}s/{{i|Sister Maggy}}s to be created.
* {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Both the duplicated familiar (if one is available) and Brother Bobby/Sister Maggy (if not available) can be sacrificed for an item reward. This does not remove the trinket, and fully retains its effect.
sections.Interactions:
* [[Familiar#Mimicking Familiars|Movement-mimicking familiars]]: Duplicated familiars will follow the original on the same delay.
** In the case of {{i|Shade}}, a copy of the familiar will spawn even if Shade was already absorbed by Isaac.
* [[Familiar#Pickup Generation Familiars|Pickup-generating familiars]]: If they remain duplicated for enough consecutive rooms, they will give a pickup as normal. The following familiars have to be duplicated for the following number of consecutive room clears to give pickups:
** {{i|Sack of Pennies}}: 1 room (will give a coin every time it’s duplicated)
** {{i|Bomb Bag}} / {{i|Little C.H.A.D.}}: 2 rooms
** {{i|Mystery Sack}} / {{i|Rune Bag}} / {{i|Sack of Sacks}}: 5 rooms
** {{i|Acid Baby}}: 6 rooms
** {{i|The Relic}}: 7 rooms
*** Because {{i|Lil Chest}} and {{i|Charged Baby}}’s chances to spawn pickups are independent from the total number of rooms cleared with them, they have an extra chance to pay out in any room they’re duplicated in.
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{i|1up!}}: Despite the fact that it can be duplicated, Isaac will not keep the 1up if he dies while it's duplicated.
** {{dlc|r+}} No longer attempts to duplicate 1up!.
* {{i|Bum Friend}} / {{i|Bumbo}} / {{i|Dark Bum}} / {{i|Key Bum}} / {{i|Lil Portal}}: The pickup count of duplicated familiars is not remembered when they go away.
* {{i|Ball of Bandages}} / {{i|Cube of Meat}}: Upgrades the familiar instead of duplicating it.
* {{i|Best Bud}} / {{i|Bird Cage}}: If the trinket tries to duplicate it, it will instead immediately activate. Taking damage does not spawn another familiar.
** If this happens to Bird Cage as Isaac walks into a room with enemies, Bird Cage will also leap onto the enemies.
* {{i|Blood Puppy}} / {{i|Bumbo}} / {{i|Guppy's Hairball}}: The duplicate will always be at its first stage.
* {{i|Buddy in a Box}}: The duplicated familiar will be randomly generated instead of copying the original.
* {{i|Cambion Conception}} / {{i|Immaculate Conception}}: Familiars given by these items can be duplicated as normal.
* {{i|GB Bug}}: The familiar can be duplicated even if it hasn’t respawned; by constantly moving to new rooms, GB Bug can constantly respawn, allowing pickups to be rerolled indefinitely.
* {{i|Guillotine}}: The head can be duplicated, and will give an extra damage and tears up if it is. The extra head will be unable to fire tears.
* {{i|Hallowed Ground}}: Duplicate poops will also drop when Isaac takes damage. The bonuses from standing in the aura of multiple white poops does not stack.
* {{dlc|nr+}} {{i|Lost Soul}} / {{i|Star of Bethlehem}} / {{i|Strawman}}: The trinket can try to make a duplicate of the familiar, but it will always fail. This reduces the odds of the trinket giving copies of other familiars or prevents it from giving Brother Bobby or Sister Maggy if Isaac has no other familiars.
** {{dlc|r+}} The trinket will not attempt to duplicate these familiars, and will correctly spawn the default Brother Bobby/Sister Maggy if Isaac does not have other familiars.
* {{i|Mystery Egg}}: The friendly the duplicated egg spawns depends on how many consecutive rooms cleared the duplicate persisted for.
* {{i|Succubus}}: The damage multiplier from standing in the aura of multiple Succubi multiplicatively stacks.
* {{i|YO LISTEN!}}: An extra +1 luck will be given for every duplicate.

sections.Effect: * When a rock is destroyed, there is an additional 1 in 200 (0.5%) chance for a {{r|Crawl Space}} to spawn.
sections.Notes:
* Stud Finder's effect is applied when a rock is destroyed and does not depend on the rock's location.
** Any of the rocks already seen before picking up Stud Finder can be affected by the trinket.
** {{t|Shiny Rock|n}} doesn't synergize with Stud Finder, as there is no set location for the rocks that will reveal a Crawl Space when destroyed with Stud Finder.
** Unlike Tinted Rocks and normal Crawl Space rocks, whose generation is dependent on the room they're in, Stud Finder's Crawl Space generation effect mainly depends on the number of rocks destroyed, which means that the more rocks destroyed, the higher the chance to find a Crawl Space.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Mom's Box}} / {{A|Golden Trinket}}: The chance to find a crawl space increases to 1 in 100 (1%).

sections.Effects:
* [[Luck#Luck-based tear effects|Luck-based tear effects]] (i.e. [[Status Effects|status-inflicting]] tears or other effects, such as {{i|Euthanasia}}) have a higher chance of occurring.
** The bonus is equivalent to +4 Luck, but the other benefits of Luck do not apply.
sections.Synergies: * {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{i|Mom's Box|r+}}: Each copy gives an additional +2 Luck flat to the trinket.

sections.Effects:
* [[Temporary Buffs#Shield|Shield]]s Isaac for 1 second after killing an enemy.
** If another enemy is killed while Isaac is shielded, another second is added to the shield's duration.
** Up to 5 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated.
sections.Notes:
* If Isaac is in range of an enemy that explodes on death, the shield will not come up before Isaac takes damage from the explosion. Other on-death effects, like firing shots, are still guarded against.
* {{dlc|nr+}} In {{r|Arcade}}s, {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s or {{e|Devil Beggar}}s can be used without losing health by killing the red flies from {{e|Shell Game}}s and gaining a shield.
** Additionally, losing in a {{e|Hell Game}} always spawns a red spider, the shield generated from killing it guarantees a payout for each half-heart.
* During the fight against {{E|Ultra Greed}}, destroying {{E|Ultra Greed Coin (Spinner)|text=Ultra Greed Coins}} will not grant a shield, despite being considered enemies.
* Destroyed {{e|Shopkeeper}}s also grant a shield.
sections.Synergies:
* {{A|Golden Trinket|r+}} / {{I|Mom's Box|r+}}: Having either increase the shield duration to 1.5 second and 7.5 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated. Having both increase the shield duration to 2 seconds and 10 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated.
* {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Isaac can chain-kill enemies without taking explosion damage while the shield is active.
sections.Interactions:
* [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t activate the shield or extend its duration.
* {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don’t activate the shield or extend its duration.
* [[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that are frozen don't activate the shield or extend its duration.
** Because of this interaction, when Isaac has {{i|Uranus}}, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will activate Sigil of Baphomet's effects, thus rendering the trinket quite difficult to use.
** {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do activate the shield and can extend its duration.
* [[Friendly]] Enemies: When friendly enemies spawned by items die, they activate the shield or extend its duration.
